Like many of the early enemies that the Straw Hat Pirates face, the Bayan Pirates are mainly a group of normal humans with only two decent fighters, Bayan and Zap. It is in fact one of the few crews that the leader is actually weaker than his subordinates, as Bayan relied on his orchestra's unique ability to control others, having no means of combative skill, while Zap was another run-of-the-mill brute depending on physical prowess and weapons to win fights. He is also easily dealt with by more sophisticated fighters.

The Bayan Pirates' jolly roger consists of a typical skull with no crossbones. The skull has blue hair resembling Bayan's, angry-looking eyes and an open mouth with a sideways treble clef between the teeth and the letters "BA" on the left and "AN" on the right.

The Banzai Pirates are a crew commanded by Banzai.

Not much is known about the crew as they have only made one appearance. They were residing on the island the Straw Hat Pirates washed up on after having there memories taken by Noko and Tatsu, but it is not known how the Banzai Pirates got to the island. They were later seen trying to prevent Nami, Robin and Vivi of leaving an island after they discovered "too much" about the Baroque Works, which inferes they were at least associated to the organization. Banzai, Bravo, and Harasho are the only known members.

Banzai and his crew, despite being able to successfully attack and hurt the Straw Hat Pirates, are fairly weak, as they were swiftly defeated after the opposing pirate crew regained their memories about how to fight. The crew is at its strongest when they band together, as seen in their combined technique.

The Dynamo Team is a group associated with the Ruluka Government. They appeared in the Ruluka Island Arc. The group of two men helped Lake and Wetton by pumping power into their respective battle suits, the Electric Suit and Flame Suit.

Of the two members of the Dynamo Team, the one who operates the pedals of the machine is a normal-sized, slightly pale man who wear the Ruluka Government uniform.

The one who carries the tubing that transfers the energy is larger with slightly tanned skin and wears the Ruluka Government uniform.

The Dynamo Team is quite loyal, powering both suits of their leaders. They seem to hate their work, since they grunt and breath heavily when increasing the power levels.

The Dynamo Team seems to have decent strength, since they could to power Lake's and Wetton's suits. However, they seem to lack much stamina, since they were breathing heavily afterwards.

The DX Marines are an independent justice-enforcing organization started and led by Commander-in-Chief and former Marine Smash.

They are the antagonist group in One Piece world having taken over Madatascar Island.

The organization's current status is unknown, as Smash was arrested and imprisoned in Impel Down.

The DX Marines were created by Smash on the belief of "absolute justice". Smash created the organization after he felt the Marines' justice was wavering.

The organization's name, "DX", is short for "Deluxe".

Despite being an offshoot organization from the Marines, the DX Marines' ranking system is completely different, more closely resembling authoritarianism.

The highest rank, held by Smash, is Commander-in-Chief (総司令, Sō shirei), which holds power of the rest of the organization and the territories it occupies.

The second-highest rank, held by Bildy, is Chief of Staff (参謀, Sanbō), which has authority over the organization's lesser members and the Seven Generals.

Courtesy of Bildy's abilities, the DX Marines created a group called the Seven Generals (七将軍, Nana Shōgun). The Generals are comprised of lesser members of the organization who have been transformed into well-known figures. Their ranks include fake versions of Hody Jones, Crocodile, Rob Lucci, Eustass Kid, Buggy, Galdino, and Boa Hancock. Due the nature of these transformations, the members who have taken these forms have the same strength and abilities as their real counterparts, greatly bolstering the power of the organization.

The Drayke Pirates are a crew commanded by Drayke and are the main antagonists of Legend of the Rainbow Island.

Not much is known about the crew, but they reside in the Grand Line and are able to travel to the East Blue with ease. Their primary goal is to find the treasure of Rainbow Island.

The Dance Pirates are a crew commanded by Creese.

At some point in the past, Creese founded the Dance Pirates in an unknown ocean. Eventually, the pirates traveled to the Grand Line, where they stopped at Drum Island. While on the island, Creese was the victim of an avalanche, but was saved by Chopper.

Upon hearing about Chopper joining the Straw Hat Pirates, Creese and her crew assumed that he had been forced into the crew, and vowed to save him.

When the pirates were on Water 7, Creese was confronted by the Straw Hats, who were trying to claim her bounty. Recognizing Chopper, she challenged them to a fight, but was swiftly defeated. The Straw Hats asked how she knew Chopper, and she explained their history. However, Chopper told he had joined the Straw Hats because he wanted to, reassuring her and her crew.

Her bounty was later claimed by the Straw Hats.

Whether the Dance Pirates are still active after Creese joined the Bounty Pirates is unknown.

The Collection Party was a tax collecting paramilitary force from the Ruluka Government, shown in the Ruluka Island Arc. The group was led by Flip.

The Collection Party are a group of soldiers, similar to the city's other armed forces, clad in the same purple uniforms and silver-blue helmets. Their task is to collect exorbitant taxes for almost anything of the citizens of Ruluka, such as taxes for eating and drinking food that was already paid for, so that the mayor Wetton can satisfy his greed and complete the construction of the Rainbow Tower.

When Wetton was arrested for his past crimes of piracy, the Party was disbanded along with the Government that formed it.

The Cidre Guild is a gang of bounty hunters led by Cidre.

The Cidre Guild's main members consists of its leader and his officers. The lowering ranking members are actually citizens who were forced to work for the organization and create weapons for them. Their main objective is to eliminate any and all pirates they would encounter, regardless if they are affiliated with the World Government or not.

The Cidre Guild uses equipment and weaponry powered by carbonated water and their base is at the island where large amounts of cola and carbonated water are made. The Cidre Guild also have different units at their disposal for hunting down pirates for their bounties and serve as scouts around the island until Luffy and Hancock defeated the leaders.

The Cidre Guild uses machinery and weaponry that is powered by carbonated water and produced in a factory on an island where carbonated water is abundant.

The Gasparde Pirates were a pirate that was headed by former Marine officer, "General" Gasparde, and his right-hand man, Needless.

It seems that the crew is roughly above average for Grand Line pirates, reaching into the Grand Line and winning in the Dead End Race every time before meeting the Straw Hat Pirates (however every time was due to cheating), and were strong enough to defeat the pirate Willy and his crew of fish-men. They, however, were not strong enough against the likes of Shuraiya and Luffy, as they fell at their hands. The crew also seemed to be almost entirely reliant on its two main fighters, their captain Gasparde and his right-hand man Needless; with Gasparde being the more powerful of the two due to his powerful Ame Ame no Mi abilities.

Despite the lower echelon looking up to their captain due to his reputation and strength and even using his name to induce fear in others, the crew has absolutely no sense of camaraderie, as Gasparde sees his crew as nothing but "underlings", refusing to acknowledge, let alone protect, anyone who failed him and literally tossing them away like garbage, while the right-hand man Needless and ruse-member Shuraiya both wanted to kill the captain (though for different reasons). Some members are even forced to join as workers in the boiler room, making this one of the few known crews to forcefully recruit members.

Their flag is something of a rarity, as it is a standard Marine flag, crossed out with a red X. This is a sign of Gasparde's defection from the Marines. Crew members have the symbol tattooed with the X replaced by two crossed swords.

The Ganzack Pirates were a group of pirates led by Ganzack.

The Ganzack Pirates had the strength to overtake Medaka's island, but they were easily defeated by the Straw Hat Pirates.

The Ganzack Pirates possessed a massive warship, 150 meters long, built by Ganzack to achieve his goal of conquering the Grand Line. The ship is a massive, complex machine. Built beneath his fortress by the enslaved islanders, Ganzack unveiled the warship after putting down a rebellion. Ultimately, however, the joint forces of the islanders with Luffy, Zoro, Medaka, and Nami defeated Ganzack and sank the ship.

The warship was huge. In addition to spikes and cannons, it has several special weapons. In the bow of the ship, there was a chamber for the Plesiosaur. On top of the fortress was a massive dynamite gun, a weapon of mass destruction.

The Gally Pirates are a pirate crew that appeared in Romance Dawn. Their captain is Crescent-Moon Gally.

The Gally Pirates are strong enough to pose some threat to a small town. Their captain, Gally, seems to be stronger than the rest of the crew and is a famed pirate in the East Blue as one of the "Big Three" pirates. The crew was no match for Luffy, including their captain, who was easily defeated.
The crew's Jolly Roger is depicted a crescent moon and a skull.

G-8, officially Marine "Grand Line" Eighth Branch, is a Marine Base occupying Navarone Island, with buildings along the coast and the most important ones built into a rock formation in the middle of the cape. The only way to enter and exit is through a large gate blocking the cape. It is the main setting of the G-8 Arc, in which the Straw Hat Pirates have to find their way out of the base.

The Marines of G-8 are fiercely proud of their base and island and berate those who undermine its importance. However, the base is "peace crazy"; it is one of the most heavily defended and armed of the marine bases (the main base alone sports a total of 108 cannons), yet sees very little trouble. This has got to the point that the first four rules of G-8 marines involve eating one's meals completely.

A Marine Chief Petty Officer working alongside Lieutenant Drake. He has curly black hair and a mustache. He seems to hate carrots and tomatoes.

He is seen standing alongside Vice Admiral Jonathan and other marine officers during the gathering at Marineford in preparation for the battle with Whitebeard.

He has grayish-purplish hair and wears dark glasses. As a Marine, he attempted to capture the Straw Hat Pirates and stop them from recovering their gold. Before he could finish warning the pirate group, he was shot by Usopp. Later, when Shepherd showed up to catch the Straw Hats, he tried to warn Shepherd not to underestimate the Straw Hats; but Shepherd insulted him and his group. He was first shown showing Vice Admiral Jonathan the books on the Going Merry.

He is a Marine chef that serves as a subordinate to Head Chef Jessica. Unlike the other cooks, he wears a green ascot to distinguish himself as the sous chef. He and the other cooks were shocked to learn that Sanji was a pirate and even attempted to seize him. However, they were also worried for him when they heard that the Straw Hat Pirates were about to get caught in the "fangs of Navarone". With his help, the cooks were able to convince Jessica to use Sanji's curry recipe.

He is the head custodian at G-8. He has a mustache coming out from his nose and a beard. Across his forehead is a bandana that has the words "班長" (literally meaning "group leader"). He also wears an apron, and on the back of it has the words "当番", meaning "on duty". He mistook Nami for a cleaning girl when she changed into a apron to trick the Marines.

The Ruluka Government is a government that existed on the island of Ruluka, somewhere in the Grand Line. It was headed by Wetton, then-mayor of Ruluka and former pirate captain.

When Wetton retired from piracy and took over Ruluka for his goal of living peacefully, he created the Ruluka Government to rule over the islanders with an iron fist.

The Government's chief goals consisted of forcing people to pay horrendously high and silly taxes, such as paying for eating and drinking food that has already been paid for, in order to gain enough money for Henzo's research of the Rainbow Mist and the construction of the Rainbow Tower, in order to steal the sunken treasures of Ape's Concert.

The Government applied its will by deployment of its soldiers. The uniforms of these men consisted of a purple suit and a helmet, adorned with the former Pirate Jolly Roger of the Wetton Pirates. Subdivisions of the governmental soldiers include the Collection Party and the Dynamo Team.

Any people who opposed the Government would be sent to a labor camp, where they would be forced to partake the construction of the Rainbow Tower "in hellish hard labor from dusk till dawn".

The Government is now defunct, its leaders having been arrested for pirating on salvaged treasure by Rapanui Pasqua of the Marines.
The Précieuses are a trio of fish-women who serve under Gad. They were formerly members of the Simon Pirates. They members are: Saphir, Rubis and Emeraude.

The Organ Dealing Assassination Group is a group of assassins who were associated with the organ trader Jigra.

Not much is known about this group, other than that they collect, especially through murder, and sell organs. The grunts wear purple suits, red afros, and white masks.

The grunts are highly proficient swordsmen, being able to deflect numerous bullet volleys fired by the Fire Tank Pirates. The four members who lead them are extremely skilled fighters consisting of a wolf mink, a muscular strong man (who is impervious to bullets), a chain sickle wielder, and a knife wielder. They easily overpowered a majority of Bege's men, but they were no match for Oven and Daifuku.

The Opera Pirates are a crew commanded by Lazarus.

While performing across the Grand Line, Lazarus accrued a group of fans who began to follow him, eventually forming the Opera Pirates.

While on Water 7, the Straw Hat Pirates challenged Lazarus for his bounty. The Straw Hats quickly defeated him, turning him in to Margin and claiming his bounty.

The Neo Marines were a splinter faction of former Marines led by admiral Z in order to annihilate all pirates in the New World.

The Neo Marines are a splinter group composed of former Marine officers that had trained and worked for Z, malcontent with the way their original counterparts have handled pirates. They seem to act upon the line of radical vigilantes, believing that pirates must be eliminated on sight, and that merely imprisoning them is ridiculous. Their loathing towards pirates is apparent, they would go to the extremes to achieve their agenda, even if it means directly opposing the Marines and World Government, such as intercepting a prison ship to murder the arrested prisoners, stealing a powerful weapon from the Marines, and raising a jolly roger. The Neo Marines' ultimate ambition, the Grand Reboot, is to end the Golden Age of Piracy, which they plan to achieve by using the Dyna Stone to destroy the three Endpoints to release enough subterranean magma to destroy the New World itself. Ironically, their actions and symbol are reminiscence of the pirates they despise so much, and despite their intentions of exterminating all pirates, they have been labeled criminals themselves.

Following the "army concept", all the infantry soldiers wears a standard uniform, consistent in a gray stahlhelm-like helmet and a dark gray sleeveless devise, with a belt where a sheath is hooked and the jolly roger imprinted behind. The trousers are light gray and tucked inside the dark boots. They have a jolly roger that borrows many design elements from the Marine flag, reflecting their origins and purpose. The rank-and-file troops also make use of a variety of weapons such as firearms.

Their leader, Z, who as a former admiral was considered to be ranked among the World Government's greatest military powers during Roger's era. Not much is known of their overall strength other than that they based their clandestine operations in the New World. However, Shuzo's forces proved to be capable of taking on four Marine warships and a Vice Admiral with the former being a former Marine Commodore. They have even armed themselves with Dyna Stones stolen from the Marines, weapons of mass destruction that rivals the Ancient Weapons in terms of sheer power. Furthermore, with a fleet of several hundred warships, three Devil Fruit users, and a Pacifista army at their disposal, they were considered a force going toe to toe with the Straw Hat Pirates.

The Neo Marines' jolly roger has a skull with slanted eye-sockets and a spiky crown, while the cross-bones are similar to an inverted Marine symbol and a cross or sword with a Yoru-like hilt, which symbolizes the organization's disdain for both pirates and the marines. The placement of the skull on top of the inverted "wings" gives the skull the appearance of an elongated tusks.

The Neo Marines possess a large fleet of ships, most of which seemed to be built among the lines of ironclad warships, with steel plates as hulls, but the bow made of wood, and large enough to have multiple sails. The admiral 's flagship, the White Tiger, is larger and with more elaborate design.

Shuzo has a submarine composed of steel, with only parts of it having wooden sides, and the insignia imprinted at the front, as well as command of an entire fleet of torpedo-like submersibles to carry his platoons.

Majin Soldiers are a race of beings brought to life along with the Evil Guardian by the orb.

Majin Soldiers are robot-like beings that float above the ground. It is unknown how they do this. All Majin Soldiers have common features: their bodies are split into a top part with their abdomens, arms, and head and a bottom part of a hollow cup-like appendage with a crystal tip at the bottom. All of them also have gold facial features.

Majin Soldiers have variable strength, with the Soldier types comparable to characters like Spandam and Nefertari Vivi. However, General types have higher strength similar to that of Weakling Trio (Nami, Usopp, and Tony Tony Chopper) and have mirrored attacks from East Blue and Grand Line fighters.

There are four "Soldier" type and three "General" type Majin Soldiers. These are: Sword Soldiers, Knuckle Soldiers,Mass Soldiers,Golem Soldiers,Green Generals, Violet Generals and Red Generals

Majin Soldiers are only capable of basic speech, repeating a few phrases, but they have more complex intelligence. This is seen in the Sword Soldiers' ability to strategically take Popora hostage from the Straw Hat Pirates and the Mass Soldiers' deceptive tactics of disguising themselves as rocks to attack in stealth.

Sword Soldiers are sword-wielding Majin Soldiers with blue, light-blue, and gold patterning. Their right arms take the form of swords as a manifestations of their hatred, which they use to slice at enemies. Sword Soldiers can drop Clay and Waste Iron.

Knuckle Soldiers are fist-fighting Majin Soldiers with orange, brown, and gold patterning. Their intense desire to reject outsiders manifests in its arms, which are able to be launched away from their bodies as projectiles to attack enemies. Knuckle Soldiers can drop Clay and Gunpowder.

Mass Soldiers are sphere-like Majin Soldiers with brown, red, and gold patterning and glowing yellow eyes. They can disguise themselves as boulders by folding their limbs into their rounded central bodies, a manifestation of their desire not to be harmed. Mass Soldiers can drop Clay and Diamond Fragments.

Golem Soldiers, also referred to as Guardian Soldiers, are muscular Majin Soldiers with blue, teal, and gold patterning and glowing pink eyes. Its desire to prevent its home island from being violated manifests in an ability to strike the ground, immobilizing its enemies. Golem Soldiers can drop Clay and Crystal.

Green Generals are large Majin Soldiers and one of the Evil Guardian's stronger minions, bearing green and gold patterning. It draws power from its opponent's memories and can read their attacks. Green Generals drop Clay and Steel Stone.

Red Generals are large Majin Soldiers and one of the Evil Guardian's stronger minions, bearing red and gold patterning. It can read special attacks from its opponent's memories. Red Generals drop Clay and Enigmatic Shells.

Violet Generals are large Majin Soldiers and one of the Evil Guardian's stronger minions, bearing purple and gold patterning. It can read attacks that trifle opponents from its enemies' memories. Violet Generals drop Clay and Magnetic Stone.

The Insect Pirates are a crew commanded by Insk, who is also the only member.

The only crew member is Insk. While there were other members in the past, they got scared of the insects filling the ship and all left.

Insk heard about new types of rhinoceros beetles and hornets living on Dressrosa, and he traveled there to try and capture them. While there, his bounty was found by the Straw Hat Pirates, who tracked him down. Upon realizing he was unknowingly looking for the Tontatta Tribe, the Straw Hats got worried he might attack them and quickly defeated him, turning him over to Margin to claim his bounty.

The Hyena Three are three pirates who act as the subordinates of the primary antagonists of the first two films. The group consists of Danny, Denny and Donny.

Danny has purple hair tied in a short ponytail at the top of his head, and a prominent nose. He wore a stripped yellow shirt with a blue vest over it, short blue jeans with light blue polka dots, a blue pirate sash, simple black shoes, and a pair of round sunglasses on top of his head.

Denny has black fuzzy hair that has a disco style to it, a goatee of the same color, and a square face with a somewhat big nose. He wore pink disco clothes that has white edges, a purple pirate sash, and white shoes.

Donny has short pink hair that is parted to the sides, revealing his forehead. He wore what appears to be a casino employee suit complete with bow-tie, and a open black jacket over it with the onsen signs on the collars, gray pants with a red pirate sash, and black shoes.

Under the services of the Trump Siblings, the three dressed as what appears to be giant playing cards as part of their costumes, following the crew's theme of playing cards.

All three of seem to confident individuals when affiliated and working with others. They have also shown a worried side of them, as they fled from Monkey D. Luffy after he defeated their captain Eldoraggo.

When working for the Trump Siblings, the trio claimed that Bear King was a better leader than Eldoraggo, though their former leader's defeat left them a fear of Luffy, to whom they fled from upon sighting him.

The Hunger Pirates are a pirate crew seen on Jail Island. The Hunger Pirates' place of origin or background is unknown, but they have a reputation of being feared on Jail Island. They had no qualms about taking food from children, demonstrating their greedy and selfish nature.

The Hunger Pirates are composed of three unnamed members. They all have yellow-tinted skin, and one is significantly taller and more muscular than the other two, more average-sized members. It is unknown if any of the members shown are the captain or simply subordinate members.

The Hunger Pirates are not strong, as they were easily defeated by Monkey D. Luffy. The crew claims to have an "ultimate technique" that they use against strong opponents, called the Eat-and-Run, but the technique is only grabbing food from people and running away.

The Hot Wind Marines (literally meaning "Hot Wind Unit") is a Marine unit that appeared in the G-8 Arc. They are the 55th Unit of the G-8 branch.

As part of their style of combat, this group sings according to the "wind of their souls". Most of them also appear to be sweating profusely because of their hot-blooded, pumped up temperament.

They are a group of powerful Marine soldiers, who fight and sing according to the "wind of their souls". However, they were almost easily defeated by the Straw Hat Pirates.

The boxing Marine uses boxing gloves that can extend to emulate Luffy's Gomu Gomu no Pistol.

The World Pirates is a pirate crew founded by Byrnndi World that was infamous 30 years ago.

The World Pirates were a formidable crew three decades prior to present history, as their captain being both their strongest member and a former prisoner in Level 6 of Impel Down. In the past, they were known for starting a campaign of massive destruction to both pirates, Marines, and even World Nobles alike that the World Government had formed an alliance between the Marines and other pirates who held a grudge against World. In present day, the Government would call upon all seven Warlords to face them. The combined strength of the crew officers can destroy a whole Marine warship in under a minute, while their captain alone can destroy two warships and a World Nobles' frigate at once in under 50 seconds.

However, despite their strengths, the main members of the crew were still defeated by Luffy and Hancock alone with both of them only having moderate difficulty defeating them. Though this can be attributed to them being well past their prime by this point.
The Jolly Roger is a pirates' skull with a white helmet with horns, and a yellow mustache shaped like a "W". The symbol has a dim purple circle around it, and "X" crossbones going through.

The Wetton Pirates was a pirate crew. They first appeared in the Ruluka Island Arc.

They were headed by the former pirate, Wetton when he was young, burning down Ruluka.

The crew disbanded when Wetton became mayor of Ruluka in his wish for peace of mind. The newly formed Ruluka Government used Wetton's Jolly Roger as their insignia.

When Wetton was arrested by Rapanui fifty years later, any remnants of the crew and their government became inactive if they were not arrested alongside him.
The Wetton Pirates' Jolly Roger is what appears to be a blue bull's head with a yellow ring around the nose and yellow eyes, with the crossbones behind the bull's head.

The Trump Pirates are a pirate crew under the command of the Trump Siblings, a group of animal/card themed captains led by Bear King.

The overall crew strength seems to be rather weak, despite having five bounties, two Devil Fruit users, and each commanding several crews of pirates (which is a large group altogether, similar to the Krieg Pirates). Three of the captains, Boo Jack, Skunk One, and Pin Joker were quickly defeated. Honey Queen, despite holding a Logia-class Devil Fruit, was easily captured. The overall leader, Bear King, was the only one who put up a longer fight, but was regardless defeated.

The crew's Jolly Roger consists of a serious bear head (in reference to Bear King), with the classic two crossed bones behind it. It also has the symbols of a deck of cards around it, with the spade on top, the club below, the diamond on the left, and the heart on the right.
Each captain commanded several pirate ships that are adorned with card symbols and animal figureheads suited to them. The main ship's figurehead is a bear with a bathtub on the top.

The Treasure Pirates are a treasure hunting pirate crew led by Mad Treasure.

The crew follows their captain Mad Treasure's desire to hunt for as much treasure as possible. Due to this, they have gathered up immense wealth, but Treasure does not care about treasure once it is kept, so they continue on searching for more.

Treasure Pirates have outfits for their slaves depending on whether they are men or women. Men's slave uniform is a brown work hat or not, ragged brown long-sleeved shirts, ragged pants white shoes, and a black collar. Female slave outfit in which they wear their hair in a pony style or not, the outfit is a pink or purple delly dancer outfit with a face veil, one or two necklaces, the top of the outfit is a V in the center front and back, there are also two pearl chains at the end of the outfit, the bottom part of the outfit is a jewelry belt, with two flowers in the middle and the rest of the fabric covering the hind legs and leaving the front legs open, shackles, black high heels and a golden collar with jewels.

Treasure commands a crew of several dozen people, although only two of them, Naomi Drunk and Psycho P, hold seniority as Treasure has trusted them to lead other crew members on missions.

Having built a reputation in treasure-hunting, the Treasure Pirates are a force capable of defeating an entire Marine fleet with a single CP0 agent onboard. Their main crew is also known for sudden ambush tactics utilizing Psycho P's Devil Fruit ability to camouflage themselves with their surroundings and even enslaving captives with their captain's Devil Fruit ability into their unwilling pawns. Those enslaved by the Treasure Pirates are kept in the hold beneath their ship as rowers.

The Treasure Pirates' Jolly Roger is a smiling skull that wears sunglasses and purple, spiky hair resembling Mad Treasure. There appears to be a chain wrapped around the neck of the skull with a yellow jewel in the center. Behind the skull are crossbones, with the top two being a shovel and a pickaxe.

The Spicy Spice Pirates are a crew commanded by Terrance. They are obsessed with spices, and regularly assault merchant ships to steal them.

While in Water 7, the Spicy Spice Pirates attacked a merchant ship, stealing all the spices they were transporting. Their captain's bounty was spread across the city, where it was picked up by the Straw Hat Pirates, who tracked the pirates down to a side canal.

After an attempt at poaching Sanji, the Spicy Spice Pirates and Straw Hats held a short fight, with the Straw Hats quickly defeating them. They returned the stolen spices and claimed Terrance's bounty.

Whether the Spicy Spice Pirates are still active after Terrance joined the Bounty Pirates is unknown.

The Simon Pirates were a pirate crew led by Simon.

The captain of the crew, Simon, was considered a candidate for the Seven Warlords of the Sea and possessed a Logia Devil Fruit which made him a powerful opponent. The four officers of the crew each had bounties of 30,000,000 Beliand possessed a good range of professions and skills which made the crew formidable. Gad was seen as the number two of the crew and was able to cause cyclones with his powers. Din had trained a large number parrots to speak and follows his orders, which allowed the crew to receive information across the Nanatsu Islands. Zabal was a skilled doctor and could effectively eliminate enemies and traitors using his medical knowledge. Niphtal had scientific knowledge and could build weapons for the crew, such as the two automaton warriors Zau Ra Zau and Kau Ra Kau.

According to Otsu, the crew had around 1,000 members in total.

The Simon Pirates had a fleet consisting of dozens of ships. The only ship to be clearly shown is one typically used by Zabal. It is a large, low set ship with two masts, a large cannon on the front, and a figurehead of an animal skull that has large horns.

The Silver Pirate Alliance is an alliance of various pirate crews based on the island of Silver Mine. They are antagonists in the Silver Mine Arc. Contrary to a typical Pirate Alliance, this group has one overall leader, Bill. However, their captain Bill only intended to use them to bring him treasure and also kill them to gain their bounties. After the defeat of Bill and the top members, the alliance dissolved.

The alliance consisted of an unknown number of pirate crews, the Sweet Pirates among them, who follow top members Bill and Peseta. Overall, there are at least dozens of members. However, the Sweet Pirates left the alliance, and the top members were all defeated, leaving only the assorted pirate crews.

The alliance exists in order to gather up as much power as possible, with their goal being to rival the Four Emperors. Prior to its leader's death, the alliance has defeated a hundred rival pirate crews, and have managed to defeat and capture multiple New World pirates with bounties like 68,000,000 Beli and 70,000,000 Beli. Due to their leader Bill's Devil Fruit power, the Silver Pirate Alliance possesses a large stockpile of weapons. The alliance also comes to work for the infamous kingpin Gild Tesoro; supplying a monthly sum of silver ore and wanted pirates as tribute to the latter in exchange for his influence and favor.

The crew's Jolly Roger is hung at their stage in their base on Silver Mine, and there is another one hung at Bill's throne room. It is blue with a silver "S" in the middle, and on top of the S is a skull and crossbones, with the skull resembling Bill's facial features. Some members, such as Bill and Peseta, have the Jolly Roger tattooed on their arm.

Battle Boats are fish, resembling real-life sailfish. Similar to how the Rosy Life Riders ride their Flying Fish, the Sweet Pirates have tamed several of these Battle Boats, and added attachments to them, making them easier to ride, both in the sea and on land. They're also equipped with dual rapid-fire cannons.
The Zona Family is a family of traveling quiz researchers. They created and manage the Grand Line Quiz, and are very wealthy.

The Tearoom Pirates are a family of pirates.

The crew lacks a lot in strength, since three quarters of the members are children. The children's father also seems to be quite weak. Despite this, Papa, the captain and children's father, has enough strength and accuracy to kill Lily Carnation with one attack. His daughter, Daisy, also has abnormally good hearing.

The Tearoom's jolly roger is a small, thin skull with large eyes and no distinctly visible teeth. The skull slightly resembles the head shape of the captain, Papa. It also somewhat resembles a mushroom.

The Omoino Family is a wealthy family living in Dressrosa.

The only known members are Kilomane and her butler, Gramoo.

The Hitaki Family is a powerful family of daimyo residing in Yo in Wano Country.

So far, the only confirmed members of this family is its late patriarch, the daimyo of Yo Hitaki, and his daughter Kikuhime. The family's teacher of ikebana Toratsugu is currently engaged to Kikuhime, and prince Lark was formerly engaged to her as well.
The Collapsing Family is a family of particularly hungry and sleepy people residing across the Arabasta Kingdom.

The Pumpkin Pirates were a group of children who pretended to be pirates that lived on Ruluka island 50 years ago.

They were allies of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Ruluka Island Arc.

The Pumpkin Pirates had at least two locations they used as a base of operations:

A cave by the shore of Ruluka where they would have fun and Henzo worked on his gadgets.

After entering the Rainbow Mist and fleeing a Sea King, they took shelter on a wrecked Marine ship that belonged to Rapanui's father until they blew it up to help the Going Merry escape.

The Red Arrows Pirates are a band of pirates. They were active during the era of Gol D. Roger.

Four Wise Men: Four Wise Men are four elderly, tiny members of the crew, each with a frog-like appearance, hence their group name. Despite this, one of them is female. They consist of Kerojii, Keroko, Keroshot and Kerodeek.

The Naguri Pirates were a group of pirates from Gol D. Roger's time.

They fought against the Roger Pirates and lost. Eventually the crew split up. Twelve years ago Naguri went out to sea to try and reunite his crew.

The strength of the crew is generally unknown, though at one point they were powerful enough to be considered a challenger to the Roger Pirates. Naguri has Haoshoku Haki, lending to the supposed former strength of the crew as well.

The Mustache Pirates was a pirate crew. It was headed by Brief.

The only named member of the crew is the captain, Brief. Including him, each of the crew members had the same kind of mustache, but none of the others were ever seen except in a photo. Brief also has a pet goat. It is unknown whether the goat joined before or after the death of the rest of the crew.

Later, Brief asked Luffy to join his crew. Luffy declined, saying he had his own crew, but acknowledged that he and Brief were friends by making the crew sign.

Brief, as the captain, was likely the strongest person on his crew. Though the rest of the crew's strength wasn't seen, they were easily defeated, captured, and killed by the Red Arrows Pirates.
The Mustache Pirates' Jolly Roger was a skull with a toothbrush-mustache and a hat, matching the crew's uniform appearance.

The Makiguso Pirates are a pirate crew commanded by Chimpy and the protagonists of Chin Piece.

The Makiguso Pirates were founded by Chimpy and Kusopp when Chimpy brought Kusopp from his village. They began exploring the ocean, eventually meeting more companions in Mechayowa Yoro, Sasoz, Dareyorimo Tsuyoi, and Chiyobbaba. They were eventually arrested for Chimpy's public indecency, but managed to escape, and continued exploring.

They continued to travel together, until they eventually encountered Yamada Shinichi. Shinichi convinced Chimpy to return to his family, and the crew split up.

The Breed Pirates is a pirate crew founded by Breed.

The Breed Pirates originally consisted of humans under the command of their captain Breed. However, after the crew mutinied against their captain and threw him overboard, Breed swore to never trust humans again and decided to only have animals on his crew. The fate of the original crew after the mutiny is unknown, but it was clear that the relationship between them and their captain was never that strong, as they considered their captain to be a selfish individual who didn't care for the feelings of others.

Breed then used his ability to enslave the Sea Animal Pirates as his new crew. Eventually, they rebelled against him as well, effectively leaving Breed without a crew once more.

It is unknown how strong the old crew was, but while Breed was in control of the Sea Animal Pirates, they proved strong enough to present a challenge to the Straw Hat Pirates. Breed himself could also augment the strength of those controlled by his Peto Peto no Mi, as shown when he used it on himself to increase his strength and muscle mass.

The Breed Pirates' Jolly Roger consists the top of a normal human skull with a crack at the top. Where the jaw should be is replaced with a blue collar with spikes (symbolizing Breed's method for controlling his subordinates), and behind the skull is a purple X with green splotches at both sides.

Breed's ship was an enormous vessel with a metallic haul and numerous sails. Her outer appearance is never fully seen, due to only being shown at night. Her interior appears to have a large aquarium room filled with water, as well as a docking area for submarines with plants in it. One area of the ship resembles the interior of a circus, which fits with Breed's ringmaster theme. There is an area filled with prison cells where Breed keeps his slaves, and numerous Surveillance Den Den Mushis are kept there for monitoring the slaves. There are also numerous speakers placed across the ship, which Breed uses to broadcast his voice to make sure his slaves never miss an order and are unable to ignore his commands.

When Breed was captain of his old crew, they had a ship with a metal haul similar to the later one. It is unknown how Breed acquired a second ship after he was abandoned. After Breed was thrown off his old ship, he was briefly forced to sail the seas on a small boat.

The Laotour Bandits are a group of bandits led by Ko. They seem to be strong, being able to easily defeat Niphtal's subordinates. They also use an assortment of weapons, such as a large pole, guns and a large axe while in battle.

Orenami Fanclub is a club of fans who idolize Nami, and is formed out of four boys in Little East Blue. It roughly translates as "I'm in the Nami Fanclub". The names of the members of the Orenami Fanclub have not been given yet, but some characteristics are known about them.

Each member has a letter shaved onto their heads and another letter on their shirt. All together, they form the words "Love Nami" by having each letter of "love" on their heads and each letter of "Nami" on their shirts. Each member also wears a pin on them that has Nami's mangrove symbol on it.

The first member is a heavier-set boy with bowl-cut black hair and a tear shaped nose. He wears a pink t-shirt with the number 14 on it and yellow shorts. His hair has the letter "L" shaved into it and the letter "N" on the back of his shirt. He wears his club pin on his chest above his heart.

The second member is a tanner boy with buzz-cut brown hair and a widow's peak. He wears a pink baseball cap backwards on his head, a short-sleeved yellow hoodie, and jeans. His hair has the letter "O" shaved into it and the letter "A" on the back of his shirt. He wears his club pin on the side of his hat.

The third member has freckles on his cheeks and has brown hair that is slicked up. He wears round, orange sunglasses on his forehead, a green shirt, and black shorts. His hair has the letter "V" shaved into it and the letter "M" on the back of his shirt. He wears his club pin on his chest above his heart as well.

The fourth member has large lips and black hair. He wears oval shaped glasses, a short-sleeved, white and purple striped dress shirt and khaki pants. His hair has the letter "E" shaved into it and the letter "I" on the back of his shirt. He wears his club pin on the left sleeve of his shirt.

The Orenami Fanclub, obviously based on their name, idolizes Nami and is obsessed with her. Their obsession is less emotional than physical, since they have a naked statue of Nami as their symbol and spend hours with when she asks to go to Luffy since they want to spend time with her. The naked statue also implies that the four teenagers are somewhat perverted. They refer to the young pirate as "Nami-sama", which gets her very annoyed. Nami also finds their other antics, such as the letters shaved into their hair and on their shirts and the naked statue, quite annoying as well.

The Barbar Pirates are sand pirates of the Arabasta Kingdom. The Barbar Pirates are skilled sand sailors. It is shown that they often clash with desert bandits. They travel the desert searching for food. All the members wear little umbrellas on their heads. While searching for water, Luffy accidentally broke the Barbar Pirates' ship and decide to go to Melias to search for wood in order to repair their ship.
The Barbar Pirates' Jolly Roger is a white skull with Barbarossa's fuzzy, gray beard. Two dark pink-colored umbrellas with yellow handles stick out on both sides of the skull.
The Fischer's Pirates are a pirate crew consisting of the members of Fischer's after being transported into the One Piece world.

The Fischer's Pirates' Jolly Roger resembles a cartoon shark, with crossbones behind it.

Despite appearing generally weak, the Fischer's Pirates have remarkable strength, easily defeating various pirate crews in the East Blue. Two of the members have Devil Fruit powers, being Peketan and Lip Shark, allowing the crew to be more diverse in their fighting techniques; Lip Shark, in particular, is able to massively boost the strength of its allies, allowing Silk Road to even beat Rob Lucci.

The Festival Pirates are a pirate crew captained by Buena Festa.

The only known crew members are the Festival Pirates' captain, Buena Festa, and Tabi.

In the past, the Festival Pirates were a famous pirate crew specializing in forming parties involving merchants and Underworld dealings. After Gol D. Roger's execution, the crew's captain, Buena Festa, went into hiding, and was thought dead. He was eventually found by Douglas Bullet, and the two began planning the Pirates Festival.

Festa began the Pirates Festival on Delta Island, with Bullet planning to kill the pirates lured there and Festa planning to use Bullet's killing spree to start his own era. Festa contacted Marine Headquarters and called a Buster Call on the island as part of the plan to trap the pirates.

Eventually, Bullet was defeated by Monkey D. Luffy. Festa mourned the failure of his plans before being confronted and captured by Sabo.

The Gejitsu Pirates are a crew commanded by Yuta.

Yuta, Ryuji, and Reika are the only members.

The Gejitsu Pirates set out to sea to find a mysterious treasure. They came upon an island and found Usopp, sniper of the Straw Hat Pirates. Usopp showed the pirates that he had a piece of the mysterious treasure, and he left the island with them to guide them to the rest of the treasure.
The Jellyfish Pirates are a pirate crew.

The Jellyfish Pirates' Jolly Roger is a skull with tentacles, resembling their namesake animal.

The crew consists of the captain Eboshi and at least two other members, Hanagasa and Kaginote.

The Long Long Pirates are a pirate crew. The Long Long Pirates' Jolly Roger resembles a normal skull and crossbones, with the exception of the top of the skull being elongated, much like Long Long's hair.

The crew consists of many members, although only five are named: Long Long the captain, Morkin, Narcie, Balong, and Nypers. These are also the few crew members with distinct appearances, with most of them being larger than average with elongated body parts and using elongated weapons (Fitting the long theme of the pirate crew). The others are foot soldiers who all resemble each other, as they all wear pink pants, no shirt, and have long beards.

The Long Long Pirates boast swordsmen in Narcie and Morkin, a strongman in Balong, and most if not all of the other members possess firearms, making them a well-armed crew. Although they were strong enough to operate in the New World, the Long Long Pirates were extremely weak compared to the Straw Hat Pirates, who took them out within minutes while sustaining no injuries or damage in the process.
The Long Long Pirates' Jolly Roger resembles a normal skull and crossbones, with the exception of the top of the skull being elongated, much like Long Long's hair.

The Long Long Pirates have several very long ships that are chained together to create a single, incredibly long ship. It has several masts and sails; the main mast that flies their Jolly Roger is extremely tall, but can be retracted in order to pass through tunnels. The ship's masthead is a long cannon that is functional and also serves as a bridge for the crew to board enemy ships.

The Mussel Pirates are a pirate crew seen on Jail Island.

The Mussel Pirates' place of origin or background is unknown, but their captain and themselves partake in Mussel Training, welcoming any newcomer.

The Mussel Pirates seem to be strong as they used their full strength to battle against Monkey D. Luffy, but they were still defeated by him.

The New Donquixote Family is a pirate crew formed by Kardia to avenge Donquixote Doflamingo.

Angry at Donquixote Doflamingo's defeat, Kardia formed the New Donquixote Family, and recruited its members. They entered the Wano Country and attacked the Straw Hat Pirates, intent on avenging Doflamingo.

The Naniwa Pirates are a crew commanded by Donai.

Donai, Nanya, and Honma are the only known members.

The Phoenix Pirates is a pirate crew, who appeared in the Ice Hunter Arc.

The Phoenix Pirates were strong enough to be able to sail through the first half of the Grand Line but their journey ultimately came to a stop when they went to the New World and the first mate of the crew, Vigaro, was killed, forcing the crew to retreat back to Paradise.

They were former pirates, who were deprived of their flag by the Accino Family and were forced by them to become their soldiers. While in the New World, they were defeated by a powerful adversary and the Phoenix Pirates Vice-Captain Vigaro died to protect his crew. With the help of the Straw Hat Pirates, they got their flag back and continued sailing.
The crew's Jolly Roger has purple wings, claws, and a fire emblem behind it, signifying the crew's namesake, a phoenix. The skull and crossbones are unchanged from a standard Jolly Roger.

The ship has a red phoenix for a figurehead. Due to the ship's initial sail less appearance, Franky thought that the pirates were probably victims of a Davy Back Fight. Its sail and the Phoenix Pirates' Jolly Roger were actually taken by Brindo.

The Otearai Pirates are a crew commanded by Sekken De Tearai. They capture other pirates, collecting their bounties.

The only known member is Sekken De Tearai.

The Zenny Pirates are a pirate crew that the Straw Hat Pirates helped to head to the sea.

Their captain, Zenny, recruited a flock of goats that he had trained to obey him. After a successful fight with the Marines, they set sail to be pirates.

Since Zenny was the only human inhabitant of the island for a number of years, the crew consists of him (as the captain) and his goats are his crewmates.

Since the crew consists of mainly goats which can fight, but with limited potential, and Zenny, who lost his strength of yesteryear, one can deduce that this crew's strength is quite low.

The Zenny Pirates' Jolly Roger is a white skull with a white headband with a single black line across the forehead, and crossbones behind the skull. There are white lines that connect to each crossbone and a single white line in the middle of the skull. There are three gold, rectangular shapes on both sides of the skull on the white lines.

The Tongari Pirates are a pirate crew who tried to recruit new members from Tongari Island's visitors.

Of the four crew members, it is unknown who leads the crew. All of the members own and wear a long black coat with golden edging and the crew's jolly roger on the back.

The Tongari Pirates' strength is unknown, as they were never shown fighting, but they were formidable enough to enter and navigate the New World.

The Tongari Pirates' jolly roger is a skull wearing a straw hat with two crossed white lightning bolts and a white and red tower behind it. Behind it as well are a yellow banner with the word "Tongari" on it, where the "T" has been replaced with a hammer and the "I" has been replaced with a saw. Underneath is the word "Island." It is also the logo of Tongari Island.

The Sweet Pirates are an all-female group of pirates led by Desire, originating from the East Blue. The crew was nearly annihilated by the Silver Pirate Alliance, and the remaining members joined the Alliance, not knowing that they were the attackers, officially dissolving the crew. Later, the remaining four members were betrayed by the Silver Pirate Alliance and set back out to sea on their own.

The crew initially consisted of Desire and several of her female friends, but everyone save Desire and three others were killed in an attack at sea. They all wear traditional Japanese sarashi bindings under long coats resembling those of Japanese street thugs, with Desire wearing a blue one and the other three wearing white ones. The members are all extremely loyal to each other, and are quick to help any of their own in peril. Desire's three crew members call her "Big Sis".

The crew's strength seems to revolve around their extremely refined boat maneuvering skills, as they even claim to be the fastest boat racers in the East Blue. They are capable of utilizing their battle boats to chase enemies and execute team-oriented hit-and-run maneuvers.

The Sea Animal Pirates is a pirate crew founded by a Kung-Fu Dugong from the Arabasta Kingdom.

The Sea Animal Pirates are full of and only sea animals, led by a Kung-Fu Dugong trained under Luffy. The crew includes:

A black belt penguin (クロオビペンギン, Kuroobi Penguin).
A sumo capybara (スモーカピバラ, Sumō Kapibara).
An octopus boxer (たこボクサー, Tako Bokusā).
A group of Sea Lapahns (シーラパーン, Shī Rapān).

The Sea Animal Pirates seem to possess a sufficient amount of strength, as they successfully made it to the New World. The captain also possesses Busoshoku Haki.
The Sea Animal Pirates' Jolly Roger consists of a Kung-Fu Dugong's face with its eyes closed and crossbones behind it.

The Schneider Pirates is a pirate crew. The only known crew members are Schneider himself and his dog Buzz. Both, however, are extremely strong, as Schneider easily knocked back Franky and Buzz has roughly the same strength as Luffy.
The crew's jolly roger has a beard similar to Schneider's own and wings that resemble Buzz's eagle form. The jolly roger also has large eyes and a frown.

The crew's ship has the design of an eagle that resembles Buzz's eagle form. It has golden trim to match the color of Buzz's feathers, a bird-like tail in the back, and a single mast that holds the crew-s jolly roger.
The 153rd Branch is a Marine Base at Shells Town and the seat of the 153rd Marine Branch in East Blue.

The 16th Branch Base is a Marine Base and the seat of the 16th Marine Branch in East Blue. It is commanded by Captain Nezumi.

The 16th branch is responsible for the region of Conomi Islands, which is where Cocoyasi Village, Nami's home village, is situated. It was also responsible for turning a blind eye on the activities to the Arlong Pirates and their tyrannical reign on the island, thanks to Arlong's monthly bribes.

As part of Arlong's scheme to keep Nami under his power once more, he tipped off Nezumi about the money Nami had gathered to buy her village from him, allowing the Marine Captain to confiscate all 93,000,000 Beli that Nami kept buried near her house.

Nezumi later attempted to claim Arlong's treasure after the Straw Hat Pirates defeated the fish-men crew, but was beaten up and then forced by Nami to return the money he had previously confiscated. Humiliated and injured, Nezumi furiously retreated to this base to report Monkey D. Luffy as a pirate to the Marine Headquarters.

The Alvida Pirates were a group of pirates led by the female pirate "Iron Mace" Alvida. They were the first enemy pirates Luffy was seen to encounter. The crew has since dissolved into an alliance with the Buggy Pirates, forming the Buggy and Alvida Alliance, which later becomes the Pirate Dispatch Organization known as Buggy's Delivery. They are one of the antagonist groups in the Romance Dawn Arc.

The Alvida Pirates were known to have used Goat Island as a base.

Although Alvida's bounty of 5,000,000 Beli is above the average East Blue pirate, the strength of this crew is substantially below par for the standards shown later in One Piece. The crew has a relatively small number of members and their captain was defeated with a single blow of Luffy's Gomu Gomu no Pistol. The remaining members of her crew were too scared to fight Luffy after their captain was taken down.

Alvida then entered an alliance with the Buggy Pirates after Alvida saved their captain, Buggy. However none of her original crew or her ship have been seen since.

The Alvida Pirates' Jolly Roger is a traditional skull on crossed bones. However, the skull is depicted from the side and has a pink heart on it. It's the first of very few Jolly Rogers in One Piece on which the skull is seen in profile.

The Alvida Pirates originally used the Miss Love Duck as their main ship. After Alvida herself was defeated by Luffy, left her crew and consumed the Sube Sube no Mi, she is seen on a new ship, introduced in Buggy's cover story. She picks up Buggy who was also defeated by Luffy and they reunited with the Buggy Pirates. Neither this ship nor the Miss Love Duck has been seen since, as Alvida boarded the Big Top. The entire ship is shaped like a heart in design. It has hearts that encircle the entire ship across the sides. In place of a Jolly Roger on the sail, it has eight hearts in a line. It also has a small table on one end of the ship.

The Arlong Pirates were a pirate crew led by Arlong. Every member of the crew was a fish-man, except for Nami (who later left). They existed before the Sun Pirates but joined with them when they were formed. After the death of Fisher Tiger, they split from Jinbe's crew after he became a Warlord and became their own crew once again. They believed they were above humans as the stronger species and looked down on them as inferior. After they were defeated, they were arrested. Due to their actions and role, they are the main antagonists of the Arlong Park Arc. After their leader's defeat by the Straw Hats, they are arrested and the crew itself is disbanded. Momoo was never taken into custody and Hatchan later escaped.

The Arlong Pirates were known to have the following territories under their control: Conomi Islands, Arlong Park, Cocoyasi Village, Gosa Village, Twenty villages were part of their territory that would have gone on as the founding of the Arlong Empire.

Not only did they have the advantage of being born fish-men, but the crew were fearsome fighters and almost unbeatable underwater. Members of this particular crew also seemed to be stronger than most other fish-men, though this is probably to be expected, having been once led by a Warlord-level pirate, Jinbe, and having experience from the Grand Line. Hatchan, in particular, was able to best three other fish-men, much like himself, from time to time in a matter of seconds. For the Straw Hats, this was the toughest of their early fights, pushing them all to their limits (though much of the pressure on Sanji and Zoro was due to Luffy's recklessness and Zoro's injury).

Their captain Arlong was not bothered by Luffy having a Devil Fruit power and took advantage of his weakness to the effects of the sea. Arlong had a keen eye for talent that could be used for his ambitions and was able to make use of the skills bestowed upon him and his crewmates, even though he had lacked the resources to pay for more experienced soldiers such as Hyouzou. With Nami's sea charts, they could tactically take advantage of ocean currents by blocking them with boulders to create whirlpools. With the Marines focusing their attention on the Grand Line and the incapacitation of all other major East Blue pirate crews by the Straw Hats, there would have been nothing to stop them from taking over East Blue if the Straw Hat Pirates had not intervened.

After Arlong's defeat, Hody Jones and his crew wanted to carry on his legacy and make it their goal to make the fish-men the ultimate race and sink the humans into the ocean. Although in the end they were also defeated by the Straw Hat Pirates.

Arlong's flag is that of a saw-nosed shark turned to the left with the tail curving inward. Around the shark is a semi-oval with three curves emitting from it. Behind the shark is a cross bone. This flag is tattooed onto all members of the crew. Several members of the New Fish-Man Pirates, Hody Jones and Hammond in particular, also have this tattooed on to their bodies, out of respect for Arlong and his ideals.

Though the opinions and ideals of the crew were extreme, they displayed a high level of brotherhood amongst themselves and even towards Nami despite her species divide. Arlong looked after his crew members and even though he betrayed Nami, he did so because he did not want to lose her talent. On top of this, in the final moments of the battle with Luffy, he stated that Nami was his crew member and would be forever, and while he never displayed any regard for her as a friend, he was prepared to fight to keep her in the crew. If humans insulted their group, Arlong would react, his officers they would attempt to keep his temper under control. When weaker members of his crew were hurt, Arlong would seek out revenge on those who had committed the act against those crew members. The level of companionship between the pirate group was therefore quite high in comparison to other crews who do not even show concern when a crewmate is hurt, defeated, or even killed. There was also a high level of respect amongst their crew towards Arlong and his officers.

On top of this, many of their crew members carried the "mark of the sun" and had previously been in the Sun Pirates. Although not all of those who carried the mark were slaves, this is still worth noting as the Arlong Pirates had a number of crew members who had subject to the shared experiences of those on board the Sun Pirates ship. As a result, a few, or possibly all, of those former members may have been driven by those personal experiences as former slaves.

The crew's loathing towards humanity was quite well known, and had a huge influence on the New Fish-Man Pirates, who used Arlong's Jolly Roger as "an empty symbol for human-hating fish-men to gather under." To this end, Hody Jones and Hammond even tattooed the symbol on their own bodies, despite having lost respect for Arlong himself for being defeated by Luffy.

The Ammo Knights serve as the royal guards for the Neptune Family on Fish-Man Island. They wear large striped spiral shells as helmets and shoulder pads with their eyes covered by a black mask of some kind. The helmets have a spike sticking out in the front, similar to a that of a unicorn. They carry tridents with them. 

The Ammo Knights are presumably strong being the royal guard of Fish-Man Island. They are powerful enough to maintain law and order in the kingdom though they were no match for the New Fish-Man Pirates, although the pirates needed energy steroids to win implying that the Ammo Knights are stronger than normal Fish-Men.

The Buggy Pirates are a band of pirates led by Buggy, a former Roger Pirates apprentice.

Initially an undistinguished (albeit feared) presence in the East Blue, it began pursuing a vendetta after being defeated by the Straw Hat Pirates, and followed them into the Grand Line. Since then, several unlikely circumstances and Buggy's constantly-revolving fortunes have repeatedly overhauled it: first into an alliance with the Alvida Pirates, then into the Seven Warlords-affiliated Buggy's Delivery, and finally into the Four Emperors-affiliated Cross Guild.

The crew, being one of the first to appear, is initially one of the weakest crews Luffy meets on his journey. They were defeated by the Straw Hats pirates in their early days when Luffy, Nami and Zoro were the only members and later were defeated in Loguetown by the Straw Hats and the Marines. It is possible, however, that they have grown in strength since then. One hint of this is that in Loguetown, Cabaji unveils a new technique to take out several of the Marines. Another hint that they probably became stronger is that although most average pirate crews simply cannot survive on the Grand Line, they seem to be perfectly capable of operating on it. Also, the fact that their crew has a Devil Fruit user such as Buggy, who not only having the experience of sailing on the Grand Line once before but also being a trainee on board of Gol D. Roger's crew, puts Buggy's crew on par with most other Grand Line crews. At this point, they have made it halfway through the Grand Line, something few pirate crews ever do. As their captain Buggy is now an Emperor, this makes them one of the four most powerful pirate crews in the world. Their power was further strengthened when their Captain formed the Cross Guild, recruiting former Warlords of the Sea, Sir Crocodile (former Leader of the Baroque Agency) and Dracule Mihawk (known as the World's Strongest Swordsman) in the process and issuing bounties on Marines, increasing their power and influence throughout the world.

The crew's Jolly Roger features the standard comic-style skull-and-crossbones, modified with a large red nose and black "makeup" crosses on the eye sockets—both reflecting Buggy's personal motif. Following the timeskip, a new version of the Jolly Roger is seen on Buggy's hat. This version has been updated, with the eyes of the skull now featuring smaller crossbones covering them, which mirror Buggy's face paint. The nose is also significantly smaller, likely a result of Buggy's own insecurities about its size.

After Buggy's escape from Impel Down, many fellow convicts from the prison heard of his past as a member of Gol D. Roger's crew. They missed out that he was a mere apprentice, and potentially the weakest member on board. Consequently, they came to admire him as a powerful pirate. During the course of the Summit War of Marineford, Buggy repeatedly shows his cowardice, but the convicts kept mistaking it as courage and bravado, furthering their admiration. By the end of the war, when Buggy reunited with his old crew, the convicts joined the crew, admiring First Mate Mohji and Chief of Staff Cabaji as well.

In truth, these new recruits are mostly more powerful than Buggy himself, and that they all have high bounties on their heads, but according to Mr. 3, who also joined the crew along with these other convicts and the only one who sees through the facade, their ears are so full of hope that they are half-deaf.

The Buggy and Alvida Alliance is an alliance formed by the pirate bands known as the Buggy Pirates and the Alvida Pirates (although only its captain remained from them) and led by the captains Buggy and Alvida.

Although both crews were the first opponents to be defeated by the Straw Hat Pirates, the alliance has remained relevant in the story so far. Its last known goal is finding Captain John's legendary treasure. The alliance eventually evolved into the Pirate Dispatch Organization, Buggy's Delivery, after Buggy gained new fame and followers as a Warlord.

The Bluejam Pirates was a pirate crew led by Bluejam. They came into conflict with Luffy, Ace, and Sabo 12 years ago on Dawn Island, which began with Ace and Sabo stealing money from one of the crew members.

The Bluejam Pirates have used Gray Terminal as a base of operations.

While the crew wasn't anywhere on par with the enemies Luffy faced when he started his pirating career, they were powerful enough to subdue him, Ace and Sabo as children, who even then were formidable fighters in their own right.

The Bliking Pirates was a pirate crew led by Wapol.

Though they are nothing compared to the protagonists of the story, Wapol and his cabinet managed to subdue an entire nation, and flashbacks showed Wapol easily defeating Dalton in his "ultimate form". It should be noted that Wapol did not get the chance to use this ultimate form, which he would have achieved by eating all of Drum Castle's weapons, because Nami stole the key to the armory from him.

The Bliking Pirates' Jolly Roger depicts a skull with a round, metallic jaw licking its own lips and wearing a large crown, as well as the standard crossbones located behind it. All those traits likely refer to the crew's captain's physical features, gluttonous nature and royal background.

The Blackbeard Pirates are an extremely infamous and powerful pirate fleet led by their admiral, Marshall D. Teach, better known as "Blackbeard", one of the Four Emperors.

Blackbeard was originally a member of the Whitebeard Pirates (and Portgas D. Ace's subordinate), until he murdered one of his crewmates over a Devil Fruit and defected, heading out to form his own crew. Blackbeard was Crocodile's replacement among the Seven Warlords of the Sea, having captured the wanted pirate Ace to obtain his position, but resigned after forfeiting the privilege by raiding Impel Down and recruiting several notorious prisoners for his crew from Level 6.

During the timeskip, after clashing with the remnants of the Whitebeard Pirates led by Marco the Phoenix and emerging victorious, Blackbeard usurped the status of the deceased Whitebeard as one of the Four Emperors. Following the Rocky Port Incident, the Blackbeard Pirates made Hachinosu their main base.

Blackbeard is supported by Ten Titanic Captains (10人の巨漢船長, Jū-nin no Kyokan Senchō), powerful Officers who each lead a ship and division of their own. Among those are included the four pirates who were introduced alongside Blackbeard himself during the Jaya Arc. After their break-in of Impel Down, the crew recruited not only the prison's former Head Jailer, Shiryu, but also four other pirates, their crimes so terrible that the World Government chose to literally erase their existence from history, locking them in Level 6: Eternal Hell, the deepest level of the underwater prison. Though they have yet to show their full powers, they are some of the most feared legendary criminals in the world. The Marines even said that even just one of the prisoners walking free again is unthinkable. In fact, during the riot at Impel Down, Blackbeard selected them in a "survival fight" among the Level 6 prisoners, in which they appeared to easily achieve victory with no visible injuries after the battle, making them the most powerful inmates in all of Impel Down at the time. Finally, the crew recruited former Marine Admiral Kuzan, also known as Aokiji, making them a true force to be reckoned with.

The Blackbeard Pirates' flag is that of three scowling skulls: one looking left, one looking forward, and one looking right. Behind them there are cross intersected sets of bones, in addition to the classic two.

The true strength of the Blackbeard Pirates lies in their fearsome admiral, Marshall D. Teach, better known as "Blackbeard". Initially a relatively unknown name, Blackbeard has performed the incredible feat of landing a permanent scar on Red-Haired Shanks, who is famed as one of the Four Emperors in the world, prior to eating a Devil Fruit, as well as defeating two of the division commanders of the Whitebeard Pirates, Portgas D. Ace and Thatch. When asked why he had not become one of the commanders of his old crew, Teach claimed that he did not have that "ambition". Teach ate one of the most powerful known Logia-type Devil Fruits, the Yami Yami no Mi, said to be the "most evil", and held the position of a Warlord of the Sea, until he forfeited the title after he used it to reach Impel Down and recruit the prisoners mentioned above. With the assistance of his crew, Blackbeard ganged up on Whitebeard with a barrage of gunshots and stabs and killed him in a rather cowardly fashion.

He somehow acquired the power of the Gura Gura no Mi from Whitebeard's corpse, which is said to be the strongest Paramecia-type Devil Fruit, making him the only known person in history to wield two Devil Fruit powers at the same time. Along with his extensive knowledge of Whitebeard's sphere of influence, the Five Elders have deemed him the likeliest candidate for usurping the deceased Whitebeard's place as one of the Four Emperors; a prediction which came true following Blackbeard's devastating victory over Marco and the remnants of the Whitebeard Pirates.

After the timeskip, Blackbeard's strength has increased to the point he would defeat the former Warlords Boa Hancock and Trafalgar Law, the latter having defeated Big Mom with Eustass Kid's assistance, singlehandedly. Silvers Rayleigh, the right hand of the Pirate King Roger, admitted that even he wouldn't be able to defeat Blackbeard if he fought him at his age.

After the timeskip, it appears the Blackbeard Pirates have grown much stronger and more powerful. According to Jinbe, they have been hunting and stealing Devil Fruit powers to increase their crew's overall strength, making a name for themselves as Ability User Hunters (能力者狩り, Nōryoku-sha Gari?). Indeed, Jesus Burgess has shown knowledge on this mysterious method of obtaining powers after death and attempted to do so against Luffy to gain the powers of the Gomu Gomu no Mi. Eventually, they succeeded in stealing enough Devil Fruits and were able to give most officers of the Blackbeard Pirates a Devil Fruit, increasing their overall and formerly already powerful crew's strength significantly.

Following Whitebeard's death and the events of the Payback War, Teach went on to conquer most of Whitebeard's former territories, with the known exception of Fish-Man Island, which originally became part of the Big Mom Pirates' territory after Whitebeard's death. Sphinx is currently the only other known remnant of Whitebeard's territory that is confirmed to be not under Blackbeard's rule.

Hachinosu is under their protection as they favor the festivities there. It was originally ruled by Ochoku before Blackbeard deposed of him and took the island for himself. Blackbeard also has plans to turn Hachinosu into an official kingdom associated with the World Government.

Prior to the time-skip, the Blackbeard Pirates utilized a giant raft for a ship.

The raft is made up of gigantic trees possibly wound together. Around the sides of the raft are gunports. A large mast is posted in the middle, bearing the flag of the Blackbeard Pirates and three sails. Another sail is placed at the stern of the raft, behind the main sails. The other means of propulsion, other than the wind, seems to be that the crew uses paddles or oars to move the raft along. Jesus Burgess and surprisingly Doc Q were seen paddling.

The raft was first seen in the Jaya Arc, when the Blackbeard Pirates were chasing after the Straw Hat Pirates. It was broken up by the Knock Up Stream. The raft was eventually repaired by either them or someone else, but they used a stolen Marine ship to sail to Impel Down, as opposed to their own ship.

After the war, the ship was nearly broken down, due to the extremely large giant, Sanjuan Wolf. Because of this, the Blackbeard Pirates were trying to exchange the prisoner Jewelry Bonney for a Marine battleship; Shiryu commented that it was foolishly impractical for the crew to travel through the New World with the raft alone, but Burgess claimed that they were rather attached to the raft. They were, however, surprised by Admiral Akainu's arrival and fled. Since the exchange did not take place, it can be assumed that they used the raft to flee from the Marines.

After the time-skip, they have gained a signature ship called the Saber of Xebec. They have obtained numerous ships, as each of the Ten Titanic Captains have command over a ship. Currently two ships have been seen, and they now resemble actual battleships, although they have a large log on each side, which resemble the original raft.

The Black Cat Pirates are an East Blue pirate crew formerly headed by the infamous Captain Kuro, and for a time his ex-first mate Jango. They served at the main antagonists in Syrup Village.

Most of the crew is weak by the standards of Luffy's and Zoro's strength, but to the average person, like (at the time) Nami and Usopp, they were formidable and deadly. Aside from their captain they have little strength as a whole. Jango, Buchi and Sham were the only other crew members aside from Kuro himself with any real fighting ability. The standard members seemed to be unaware of the existence of Devil Fruits believing it to be a myth. The crew mostly relies on their first captain's cunning schemes and instructions for effective plundering and second captain's hypnotism for increasing their physical strength to higher levels. Upon Kuro's departure, he had taught them to survive on their own, in order to use them three years later for his own machinations.

Kuro views the crew as expendable and his habit of indiscriminately killing them due to his fighting style also weakens the crew's overall manpower (through injury and death) and undermines any true loyalty and respect they might have for their former captain, since most (if not all) of them follow Kuro out of fear. This is shown when they started cheering for Luffy to defeat Kuro. Another sign of the crew's disloyalty is the Nyaban Brothers' failed attack (an act of mutiny) on Kuro, due to their mistaken belief that Kuro's fighting skills had dulled during his three years disguised as the butler Klahadore.
The Black Cat Pirates' flag is a standard jolly roger with a skull the shape of a cat's head, completed with slitted eyes, and crossbones.

The Nyaban Brothers or Meowban Brothers are the ship guards of the Black Cat Pirates, and consists of the officers Sham and Buchi. It is their duty to watch over the Bezan Black while the rest of the crew leaves for pillaging or other purposes. Together, they earned a bounty of 7,000,000 Beli. They are also the top fighters of the crew, each wearing a pair of clawed gloves for combat and fighting cooperatively to overwhelm their opponents. They are called by Jango to deal with more troubling enemies when necessary, and were supposedly stronger than him when fighting together.

The Big Mom Pirates are an extremely infamous and powerful pirate crew led by their captain, Charlotte Linlin, better known as "Big Mom", formerly one of the Four Emperors. They are in control of the powerful nation of Totto Land, with their captain ruling it as its queen and their base of operations being Whole Cake Island, the country's main island. The captain agreed to an alliance with the Beasts Pirates for plans to take over the world. However, the captain was defeated during the Raid on Onigashima by two members of the Worst Generation, and she was subsequently stripped of her position as an Emperor, leaving the crew's status unknown.

The Big Mom Pirates are organized around a central group of pirates sailing directly under the former Emperor Big Mom, and various subordinate crews working directly on her orders, allowing the crew to operate as a massive pirate fleet. Specifically, the Big Mom Pirates are built heavily around the members of the Charlotte Family, with the children comprising a large portion of her crew as well as her officers and most capable fighters; however, it is unknown exactly how many of her children are direct members of her crew. Big Mom is seemingly addressed by all of her crew, family or not, as "Mama".

The crew's hierarchy is similar to the Donquixote Pirates and Beasts Pirates, with there being a captain, several elite/executive officers, many regular officers, and a legion of lower-ranking grunts. In this case, Big Mom acts as the captain, with the Three Sweet Commanders working directly under her. In turn, other children of the Charlotte Family and combatants answer to them. The bulk of the crew is composed of tens of thousands of soldiers, from homies (especially the chess peacekeepers) to people of various humanoid races.

Some of the family members have their own personal squads in the crew. The known family member's squads revealed are Cracker's, Smoothie's, and Daifuku's.

The Big Mom Pirates' Jolly Roger is a skull with thick lips and wearing a pirate tricorne based on their captain's appearance, on a fluffy background (which could represent Linlin's hair in some fashion) with several candy canes crossed behind it (one on the right, three stacked together on the left), in place of normal crossbones. A tree is seen coming out of the cane on the bottom right.

Like the Whitebeard Pirates, the Big Mom Pirates have a simpler Jolly Roger, consisting of the normal skull-and-crossbones, but retaining the large lips of the original.

A select few of Big Mom's children stand out particularly in terms of power and have been designated the Three Sweet Commanders. They serve as Big Mom's top officers with the highest authority, reverence, and fighting prowess in the crew after Big Mom herself. The trio currently consists of the 2nd son, Katakuri, the 14th daughter, Smoothie, and the 10th son, Cracker.
