It attacks by launching itself at a target like a bullet. A number of Cowballs tried to attack Sanji and Usopp; though they weren't defeated, they broke the ground below the pirates, making them fall. It has been seen on both Merveille and Delta Island.

An animal on Merveille. The Dasoku (ダソク, Dasoku, literally meaning "Snake Feet"), also known as a Mukade Hebi (ムカデ蛇, literally meaning "Centipede Snake") is a cross between a snake and a centipede. "Dasoku" (だそく) means superfluity. If separated, it literally means "snake feet" (蛇足)

The Death Risu (デス・リス, Desu Risu, literally means "Death Squirrel") is a large squirrel-like animal that lives on Merveille. A small number of them live on Waford as well, who tend to be slightly smaller than the Merveille residents.
An animal from Merveille. The Del Kong is a giant gorilla with brown fur. Its face and ears are violet, and it has protruding fangs. The front of its arms are larger than the back of it.

An animal from Merveille. The Don Kamakiriri resembles a giant praying mantis, and always seems to be angry. Its arm scythes are capable of cutting through solid stone with ease. 

"Kamakiri" means mantis.

An animal on Merveille. The Erimakitokageps is a giant purple colored lizard with a dinosaur-like appearance. It can easily break stone walls, and it seems to have very resistant horns.

Its name comes from "Erimaki Tokage" (エリマキトカゲ, Erimakitokage, Japanese name for "frilled lizard"), referring to its frill.

An animal on Merveille. The Ettousaurus (エットウザウルス, Ettōsaurusu, literally meaning "Wintersaurus") is a dinosaur-like animal that lives in snowy places. Its main color is cyan, with some black spots. It has white fur over its back, tail, around its head and under its mouth, and large antlers.
An animal from Merveille. The Fat Lion is a bloated lion with a spiky mane reaching the end of his back. His legs are small compared to his body.

An animal from Merveille. The Giragon (ジラゴン Jiragon) is a green giraffe with black hair on its neck and a long flexible neck. 

Its name is a combination of "giraffe" and "dragon" since it has a long dragon-like neck.
An animal from Merveille. The God Wind is a black dragonfly-like animal with blue eyes. It wields a spear.
An animal from Merveille. The Golden Bat is a golden bat-like animal with large red eyes.

An animal from Merveille. The Groggysaurus is a giant animal that resembles a dinosaur. Its main color is gray, with some red stripes. It has white fur above and below its head and neck. Its neck is always curved, and its tongue stays out of its mouth.

The Guntai Ari (軍隊アリ, Guntai Ari, literally meaning "Army Ants") are a group of soldier-like ants from Merveille. They act in a group, using superior numbers to attack large prey. When they find prey, they will reduce it to bones in an instant. However, they have no interest in the bones, much to the anger of Brook.
The Gyoriiza is a giant fish from Merveille.

An animal from Merveille. The Hammer Isoginchaku (ハンマーイソギンチャク, Hanmā Isoginchaku, literally meaning "Hammer Sea Anemone") is a pink colored cnidarian animal. It has mushroom-like tentacles coming from its head that can act as hammers.
An animal from Merveille. The Hippo Iron is a pink hippo with a long tail, spots, long fangs and a pig-like snout.

An animal from Merveille. The Ikahula (イカフラ, Ikafura, literally meaning "Squid Hula") is a giant squid-like animal. Its body is mostly yellow colored, with red stripes on its head. It uses dozens of tentacles to attack its enemies. 

The movement its tentacles make resemble hula dancing, hence the name.
The Joker is a bee-like animal from Merveille.

An animal from Merveille. The Juracho (ジュラ鳥, Jurachō, literally meaning "Jurassic Bird") is a bird that resembles an archaeopteryx. Its body is green, while the feathers on its wings are multicolored. Its head is black, and does not seem to have flesh or feathers. A very similar species, with the same name, lives in the Arabasta Kingdom.

An animal from Merveille. The Kaen Kabuto (カエンカブト, Kaen Kabuto, literally meaning "Flame Beetle") is a giant black beetle. It has pink fur around its body, and four horns. It is capable of breathing fire. It attempted to attack Sanji and Usopp, but was defeated. Boss resembles a Kaen Kabuto. It is considered a sub-species of the giant beetles from the Boin Archipelago. One could later be seen on Delta Island
Boss is a uniquely large beetle from the Little East Blue Arc. He was originally a Kaen Kabuto, a creation of Dr. Indigo, but escaped.
An animal from Merveille. The Kill Rabi is a wolf-rabbit hybrid animal.
The King Umi Mukade (キング海ムカデ, Kingu Umi Mukade, literally meaning "King Sea Centipede") is a water dwelling centipede. It was in a flooded volcano in an island of Merveille.
Kubinagaryu (首長竜, Kubinagaryū, literally meaning "Long Neck Dragon" or "Plesiosaur") is a black plesiosaur-like animal, with a long neck and a dinosaur body.

An animal from Merveille. The Kung-Fu Dot (カンフードット, Kung-Fū Dotto) is a spotted frog that fights using kung fu. Its hands have four fingers and are non-webbed, but its feet have five toes and is webbed.

An animal from Merveille. The Land Gator (ランドゲーター, Rando Gētā) is an enormous alligator with a flattened body.

Its flat headed design slightly resembles that of a Japanese mythological monster called a Waniguchi.

An animal from Merveille. The Mammoth Dense is a giant mammoth with large tusks and six feet. 

One could later be seen on Delta Island.
An animal from Merveille. The Maou Game (魔王ガメ, Maō Game, literally meaning "Demon King Turtle") is a giant turtle.
An animal from Merveille. The Meteor Ibex is an animal that resembles an ibex with large horns. Its body is white with black stripes, similar to a zebras.
A animal from Merveille. The Missile (ミサイル, Misairu) is a red rhinoceros-like animal. Its name comes from the word sai (ミサイル), meaning rhino.
An animal from Merveille. The Miyama Emperor (ミヤマ･エンペラー, Miyama Enperā, literally meaning "Mountain Emperor") is a large black stag beetle with horizontal white stripes on its body.
An animal from Merveille. The Monkey Trooper is a monkey that fights with weapons.

An animal on Merveille. The Mori Dako (森ダコ, Mori Dako, literally meaning "Forest Octopus") is a large land-dwelling octopus. They attack prey by restraining them with some of their tentacles and beating them with the rest of their tentacles that are curled into fist-like shapes.

An animal on Merveille. The Oh Imomushi (大イモ虫, Ō-Imomushi, literally meaning "Big Caterpillar") is a giant caterpillar seen chasing Sanji and Usopp on an island on Merveille; it fell off the island while chasing them.

An animal on Merveille. The Oh Umi Gappa (大ウミガッパ, Ō Umi Gappa, literally meaning "Great Ocean Kappa") is a giant water bug-like animal. The name may come from the kappa, a Japanese mythological water animal.
An animal on Merveille. The Rakuda (ラクダ, literally meaning "Camel"), is a bison-like animal with camel-like humps.
An animal on Merveille. The Red Fang is a zebra which looks like a large cat.
An animal on Merveille. The Rock Panda is a panda-like animal with red and blue star-like patches over its eyes and a purple coloration on its arms, ears, and legs.
An animal on Merveille. The Sazae Kancho (サザエ艦長, Sazae Kanchō, meaning "Turban Shell Captain") is an animal that resembles a hermit crab. A smaller, similar species of the same name live on Waford.
An animal on Merveille. The Screen Buffalo (スクリーンバッファロー, Sukurīn Baffarō) is a giant carnivorous buffalo with a giant beard. It attacks prey by closing in, using the snow as camouflage.

An animal on Merveille. The Seiuchi Mountain (セイウチマウンテン, Seiuchi Maunten, literally meaning "Walrus Mountain"), is a giant walrus with a blue and cyan color pattern. A closely related species, with the same name, lives in the sea around Waford.
An animal on Merveille. The Senbon Yari (千本鑓, literally means "Thousand Spears") is a large blue boar-like animal with spikes on its back.

An animal on Merveille. The Shimatori (シマトリ, Shimatori, literally meaning "Island Chicken") is a strong four-winged rooster-like animal. 

Its name comes from the Japanese words "shima" (島) which means island, and "tori" (鶏) which means chicken.
An animal on Merveille. The Shirokage (シロカゲ, Shirokage, literally meaning "White Shadow") is a white sloth-like animal.

An animal on Merveille. The Shogun Jishi (将軍獅子, Shogun Jishi, literally meaning "General Lion") is a giant lion.

Its appearance somewhat resembles the guardian lions found in some Asian cultures.
An animal on Merveille.The Spider Tank is a giant spider with the force of a tank.

An animal on Merveille. The Terror Guma (テログマ, Tero Guma, literally meaning "Terror Bear"), also known as the Long-armed Bear (手長グマ, Tenagaguma), is a black bear with white stripes on its body and long arms. The most notable features of the Terror Guma are its massive and powerful arms and its cute face. They defeat prey by grabbing them with their long arms and smashing them headfirst in the ground over their own head in a suples-like manner. 

Guma comes from the Japanese word Kuma くま/熊. The Terror Guma also resembles a gibbon, called "Long-armed Monkeys" (手長猿, Tenagazaru?) in Japanese.

An animal on Merveille. The Toramata (トラマタ, Toramata, literally meaning "Forked Tiger") is a large blue six-legged tiger with two tails and long teeth like a saber-toothed tiger. 

One could later be seen on Delta Island.

Its design and name is a reference to the Japanese mythological monster "Nekomata" (猫又, Nekomata?, literally meaning "Forked Cat"), which translates the Toramata's name to "Forked Tiger" (虎又). Its coloring appear to be based on the cryptid Maltese tiger.

An animal on Merveille. The Tsujigiri Itachi (辻斬りイタチ, Killer Weasel) is a giant weasel that carries a handmade scythe, made from a leaf that comes from a plant called a Sword Tree (剣樹, Kenju), a plant which also grows in Level 1 of Impel Down. It was seen when the animals from Merveille are summoned to the main island.

The word "tsujigiri" literally means crossroad killing, which refers to the practice in the Edo period of Japan in which bushi would kill a random bystander in order to test out a new sword. It would later refer to other needless killings committed by the bushi, and was considered socially acceptable for a time. The theme of the Tsujiri Itachi comes from the Japanese folklore monster known as the kamaitachi (鎌鼬, Kamaitachi, lit. "Sickle Weasel"). It would travel through fierce winds and cut people with its sickle shaped claws.

An animal Modified by Franky while he was on Merveille. The Batta GT-7000 (バッタGT-7000, Batta GT-7000?, literally meaning "Grasshopper GT-7000") is a vehicle designed and produced by Franky, using an animal created by Indigo as a base. Like the Zarley Davidson, the Batta GT-7000 handlebars are actually the animal's antennae tied by rope to control the brakes and movement. It was seen taking Franky, Robin and Brook to the destroyed village in Merveille.

An animal Modified by Franky while he was on Merveille. 

The Zarley Davidson is a vehicle designed and produced by Franky, after he modified the base animal that Indigo created. Though the handlebars may appear to be only for show, they are actually the animal's antennae tied together by rope. The brakes are controlled through these handles.

The name "Zarley Davidson" is a play on the Japanese word Zarigani (ザリガニ), which means crayfish, and the motorcycle company Harley Davidson.
Carrier Bat (伝書バット, Densho Batto) is a message delivery animal of the World Government to the pirates. Its name is a pun on carrier pigeon (伝書鳩, Densho Bato).

Yuda (遊蛇ユダ, Yuda, literally meaning "Traveling Snake") are a ferocious and poisonous type of sea serpent. They live in the Calm Belt and are so dangerous that they are one of the few creatures that Sea Kings will not attack, though the Kuja people apparently were able to domesticate them. The Kuja Pirates’ ship, the Perfume Yuda, is drawn by these creatures, a newly added method of navigating through the Calm Belt. They resemble Snake Weapons but are much larger and have hair on their head that also runs along their backs and around their necks, as well as having slit eyes while snake weapons have dotted eyes.

Yuda are the second species that are fiercer than Sea Kings to be owned by a Warlord of the Sea (Boa Hancock), the first being Bananawani owned by Crocodile. Both of them also represent their owner's reptilian animal themes, snakes and crocodiles respectively.

The Masukeredomo Goayu Birds (マスケレドモ・ゴアユー鳥バード, Masukeredomo Goayū Bādo, "Sayin Goabird") are large birds that live in the Kingdom of Torino, they have cyan feathers on their heads, and white hair on their backs and stomachs, their beak is red with yellow trim and pink eyes. These birds found Chopper when he arrived on the island flying by Bartholomew Kuma, and started playing with Chopper who couldn't move by spinning them around. These birds do not let humans climb the giant tree, since the majority that has gone want the eggs and their stored treasures, because of this, the inhabitants of the kingdom, who only want plants from the tree, the birds still think they want their treasures, and for this they have been at war and attacking each other. Thanks to Chopper, their problems were solved and they live in harmony, one of these birds took Chopper to the Sabaody Archipelago to reunite with his companions.

A Blue Gorilla nicknamed Blugori (ブルゴリ, Burugori) by the Impel Down guards and prisoners, is a large masked gorilla-like beast with a skull painted on where its face should be. Blue Gorillas wield double-sided battle-axes and have incredible physical prowess, to the point of hunting Sea Kings for food. However, they are mindless creatures and are under the command of Saldeath, who controls them with a flute.

The Puzzle Scorpions are scorpions found in Level 2: Beast Hell of Impel Down. The Puzzle Scorpions look like large, cartoon scorpions. When they fuse together, they look like giant centipedes. When Luffy and his company struck the animal, it immediately broke into pieces, in which it appears that the big scorpion is actually composed of smaller version scorpions. The Puzzle Scorpions are extremely poisonous. They originate from the South Blue.

The Manticores are man-eating animals found in Level 2: Beast Hell of Impel Down. The Manticore are animals with human faces, but lion bodies, being based on the legendary creatures of the same name. Each of their faces are different, similar to actual humans. They are able to imitate human speech because their face is human-like. They are only imitating what they have heard the prisoners say and they do not know what those words mean. They may refer to panties or food. Manticores originate from the South Blue.

The Basilisk is the second-in-command of Impel Down's Level 2: Beast Hell, under the Sphinx. The Basilisk is a gigantic chicken like creature, with its tongue sticking out in a deranged manner, and is said to be the offspring of a chicken and snake. While named after the basilisk, it looks more like the cockatrice; these two creatures are often confused with each other and are sometimes synonymous.

Sphinxes are large creatures with a dark humanoid face and a winged, leonine body. A giant Sphinx is the boss of Impel Down's Level 2: Beast Hell. Similar to the Manticores that it leads, the Sphinx mimics words that it hears from the people around it, but does not understand what those words mean. It usually refers to different types of noodles. It is based on the famous mythological creature.

Many are later seen residing in Whitebeard's homeland and although they appear visibly intimidating, they can be tamed and raised as pets, as seen with a little girl who owns one named Tama.

Sphinxes primarily live in the New World. They are approximately 30m (98'5") long.

The Wolf Unit (軍隊ウルフ, Guntai Urufu or "Army Wolves") are a pack of vicious wolves stationed in Impel Down's Level 5: Freezing Hell. The wolves look like typical wolves, except their strange looking eyes make them look deranged and insane, and they tend to stick out their tongues, which further increases their bloodthirsty appearances. The wolves are powerful enough to overwhelm even the top savage animals of Level 2. As such, they are reassigned to guard Level 5 criminals. The wolves also seem to be resistant to the bitter cold of Level 5. They may be the result of genetic modifications, as a wolf appears in the background when the Bloodline Elements and their modifications are being described.

A humandrill is a type of mandrill that Roronoa Zoro encountered in Kuraigana Island. They are highly intelligent creatures capable of imitating humans so much that they will mimic any trait they witness. One of the humandrills even used spit to try to heal its wounds, which is a folklore remedy. If they were to see peace they would become pacifistic creatures; however, nine years ago, they witnessed a war on Kuraigana Island, causing them to learn how to wield weapons and become bloodthirsty warriors. As stated by Mihawk himself, the only reason why humans are dominant over beasts, despite the latter's physiological advantages over the former, is because people have the capacity to learn and improve. With these advantages in the possession of beasts, they become more dominant.

The Humandrills are extremely powerful due to their beastly physical prowess which greatly supplement their self taught fighting skills. They were a major obstacle to Zoro when he tried to reach the ocean and they even destroyed the boat that Dracule Mihawk gave him to leave the island. One of them was seen withstanding Zoro's Oni Giri attack without falling to the ground, using spit to heal its wound. Perhaps a great testimony to their fighting strength would be when Mihawk reacted with visible surprise after Zoro revealed that he had defeated them all. This implies that even the Shichibukai acknowledges their strength. Nevertheless, they are afraid of the Shichibukai to the point that they do not even dare to come near his castle. The Humandrills are shown to have a peaceful side, as seen when they aid Mihawk in farming the land of the island but are seen nervous around him.

They were able to imitate Zoro's Three Sword Style techniques just by seeing them. When Zoro defeated them, Mihawk explained to him that he defeated only a part of them and that by imitating the soldier of the war on Kuraigana Island they even imitated their ranks system, thus meaning that mandrills organized themselves like a real army. Finally, the most incredible test of their high intelligence is that one of them managed to imitate Mihawk's swordsmanship, even developing a white copy of his sword, the Kokutou Yoru; thus becoming the leader of the Humandrills army.

Their name is a combination of the word "human" (which they imitate) and mandrills, the type of monkey which they resemble.

The Big Tiger (大虎, Ōtora) is seen in the forest of Goa Kingdom. It is a very fierce and big tiger that tries to eat young Luffy and also takes Luffy's "first hunting prize" 12 years ago from the current storyline, Luffy, Ace, and Sabo were no match to the tiger, even if they fought together. It seems to be able to handle cold climates since it appears in a snowy mountain before Luffy and the others. The Big Tiger has the ability to attack with its tail. Later on, Luffy, Ace, and Sabo defeat the tiger together after training with Naguri.

The Domo Penguin (ドウモウペンギン, Dōmō Pengin, "Fierce Penguin") is a type of penguin that is native to Hyokaido. It generally resembles a blue Rockhopper Penguin with a Puffin like beak. Large groups of this penguin are able to move the various icebergs in Hyokaido from underneath. The Accino Family use these penguins' ability to move icebergs to trap their prey's ship between the various icebergs in Hyokaido.

The penguins themselves are very vicious. Large groups of them can cause trouble for anyone in their way. The Accino Family thus also use the penguins' vicious nature against their prey.

The danpa (ダンパ, Danpa) is shown to be Luffy's "first hunting prize" in the Goa Kingdom. Its name is a pun on pandas, and its fur patterns are opposite from a panda's as well; dark where pandas would be white and white where pandas would be dark colored. It is not very strong compared to the Large Tiger since young Luffy "caught" it very easily. Danpas probably do not hibernate, since it is seen running away from Luffy and the trio in a snowy mountain.

Found in the Underworld of the Sea. Carnivorous Tube Worms are massive, presumably carnivorous, riftia pachyptila. They are shown to be aggressive, for example, reaching out towards the Thousand Sunny when it passed near them.

A giant crab with no visible eyes which the Straw Hats called a Flatface Crab (のっぺらガニ, Noppera-gani, localized as "Faceless Crab"). It is a very ferocious creature that pursued the Straw Hats while they explored the surface of the Underworld of the Sea. Despite having no eyes, it can hunt its prey just fine. Much like other crabs seen in the world of One Piece, it has a human-like mouth.

The Sea Turtle Elevator (ウミガメエレベーター, Umigame Erebētā) is a large turtle that has been tamed by the people of Fish-Man Island. It is used by the people (though most likely mainly by humans) to ferry them from the lower levels of the Coral Mansions to the surface and back again. The turtle's shell is large enough for several average-sized humans to stand on comfortably and has a bubble covering it which holds air for humans to breath.

The Fish Taxi (お魚タクシー, Osakana Takushī) is a large fish able to hover over land, thanks to a coating bubble, and swim in the sea and is used as transportation to cross both terrains. The coating bubble is on its back, with seats aligning its dorsal fin. It also wears a hat. There is also the Fish Bus (お魚バス, Osakana Basu) which is used to go around the Island in a similar manner to a regular bus.

The Long Flounder (長ヒラメ, Naga Hirame) is a species of fish which has been trained and employed by the Ryugu Palace. Like a normal flounder, it is very flat, with both its eyes on the dorsal side, and it's mouth on the opposite. However, as its name suggests, it is very long like an eel. Furthermore, it is large enough to carry several people on one side. After applying a coating bubble to the dorsal side, it is used as a platform to hold air-breathing humans while hosting events and parties in an underwater environment.
The spotted sharks are a big species of shark which live in the waters of the New World. The sharks are about ten times bigger than a human and their bodies are covered in spots.

Vegapunk's Dragon (Small Size) (ベガパンクの竜ドラゴン - 小型, Begapanku no Doragon - Kogata) is the second model of dragon developed. It seems to be really fierce when not sedated, but it is very cowardly against strong opponents and prefers to run from danger.

Its fire breath is less powerful compared to the first model but its body is hardier (as stated by Brownbeard). Along with that it also possesses superior agility and flight speed that make it able to easily dodge bullets, and with a joint force powerful enough to bite and chew through steel. It also seems to be able to perceive imminent danger as it immediately flew away from Smiley's toxins and when it noticed Vergo's arrival.

A Fighting Bull (闘牛, Tōgyū) is a large species of cattle with dark fur, long horns, and a bulky body. It also has small eyes, both with three thick eyelashes on each. The only known fighting bull is the one that participated as a gladiator at the Corrida Colosseum whose fighting style has led him to become known as the "Brutal Bull". He was tamed and befriended by Luffy who gave him the name Ucy.

A Fighting Lion (闘獅子, Tōjishi) is a species of white lion with whiskers, sharp teeth and a gray mane. It has dark shadows around its eyes which has pale yellow scleras and red irises. The only known fighting lion is Agyo who participated as a gladiator at the Corrida Colosseum.

Fighting Fish (闘魚, Tōgyo) are large black fish notorious for their ferocity. They have the head of a bull with fangs and a crazed look in their red and yellow eyes. These fishes are related to the Giant Goldfish.

They came to the waters between Dressrosa and Green Bit about two centuries ago and made travel impossible, capsizing ships that come close. They travel in large schools in the waters between Dressrosa and Green Bit. While lacking any natural predators, they have been known to be used as a food source by the Dwarves. Reinforcing the bridge between Green Bit and Dressrosa with iron did not make any difference. Since their arrival, nobody who has crossed the bridge has been known to return. Despite their ferocity, they are capable of showing fear as the ones around Green Bit are afraid of Donquixote Doflamingo and fled in terror when a school of them attacking the Thousand Sunny saw the Warlord of the Sea approaching the ship.

Little Fighting Fish (リトル闘魚, Ritoru Tōgyo) are a smaller, but still rather large, variant of the fighting fish. They are kept in the pool surrounding the ring of the Corrida Colosseum as a disqualification penalty for anyone who falls out of the ring.

Boss Class Fighting Fish (BOSSボスクラス闘魚, Bosu Kurasu Tōgyo) are deadlier than little Fighting Fish, though still a good bit smaller than the wild ones found around Green Bit, and can leap out of the water to reach contestants within the ring. One of each school were brought in for the battle royale between the four block winners and Diamante. Each one has a number tattooed on their left temple; the one with an "01" tattoo carried a chest with the Mera Mera no Mi inside on its back until Sabo took it. They are sensitive to the smell of blood and one with an "06" tattoo charged at some bleeding gladiators on the bridge section, crushing the bridge and knocking them into the pool.

Yellow Great Rhinoceros Beetles orGolden Rhinoceros Beetle, called Yellow Cubs for short, are large beetles used by the dwarves as mounts to fly from place to place. The Tontatta Kingdom used these to fly from Green Bit to Dressrosa. The ones used by the army have "TT-Air Force" written on their sides. They are used by the Yellow Kabu squad, commanded by Kabu, a dwarf with a Rhinoceros Beetle Zoan Devil Fruit. The mounts have helmets with the letter "K" (for Kabu) followed by a number. They are shown to be very strong fliers, as even though they cannot completely lift a human, a dozen of them working together is able to keep a full grown person temporarily airborne. Using this feature, they provide the Tontatta Airlines Jumping Service for humans.

Pink Hornets (桃色スズメバチ, Momoiro Suzumebachi, "Peach-Colored Hornets"), called Pink Bee for short, are large hornets that live on Green Bit, which the dwarves tamed. The dwarves use these as aircraft to fly from place to place. They are used by the Pink Bee squad, commanded by Bian, a dwarf with a Hornet Zoan Devil Fruit. Each hornet wears a black helmet with the letter "B" on it, followed by a number.

The Linear Foxes (リニアフォックス, Rinia Fokkusu, "High-Speed Fox") are a species of fox which has been domesticated by the dwarves of the Tontatta Kingdom.

They are big enough for average sized humans (Robin and Usopp) to ride on. These foxes have large puffy tails, which are said to be very soft, and beautiful to look at. Their fur is blue on the top of their bodies, and their underbellies are white, along with part of their tail and around their eyes. Each of the foxes sports an orange cap which reads "Express" and has a fox tail on it. They also have a sign on their sides, saying which number fox they are.

A Super Penguin (超ペンギン, Chō Pengin) was Kuzan's mode of transportation when he came to Punk Hazard, in particular, the super penguin named Camel. It is said to be good at treading water. Its coloration resembles real-life banded penguins.
Sea Lapahns are an aquatic mammal species and a distant relative of the Laphans.
A Black Belt Penguin is a large type of penguin that has a human-like stature and typically wears a karate gi. Its name and appearance is a pun on the Rockhopper Penguin (イワトビペンギン, Iwatobi Pengin).
A Sumo Capybara (スモーカピバラ, Sumō Kapibara) is a large type of capybara that stands upright like a human and typically wears a fundoshi.
An Octopus Boxer is a type of giant octopus, similar to Surume. Their name originates from their fighting style and appearance of always wearing boxing gloves.

Naitamie-Norida elephants are massive elephants whose legs stretch down to the ocean floor, allowing them to walk through oceans. The species have an immensely long lifespan and can live for more than 1000 years, and are distinguished by their disproportionately long legs which have two knee joints.

One such elephant is Zunesha, who resides in the New World. Its body structure has allowed it to carry Zou and its inhabitants for an entire millennium while continually walking.

Wanies (ワーニー, Wānī) are species that looks like a hybrid of a crocodile and a boar. They are domesticated and used as transportation by the Mink Tribe. They have a stout build with a thick tail that curls up close and four legs that are rather thin compared to their bodies. They are convenient both on land, and for swimming during Eruption Rains. One was first seen being used by Sheepshead and Ginrummy when they were pursuing Tristan. The only known named one, Wany, is owned by Wanda.

Armored Stonefish (ヨロイオコゼ, Yoroi Okoze) live in the Hot-Hot Sea (熱々海, Netsu-netsu kai) in the New World and are larger than average humans. They can be cooked and eaten except for their skin, which is very poisonous and in most cases causes instant death accompanied by a severe rash.

Luffy managed to catch one during the voyage to Whole Cake Island for the Sanji Retrieval Team to eat; however, he ate the skin and was brought to the brink of death. His built up resistance to poison saving him from instant death, it still caused his condition to worsen over a short span of time, and none of the antidote the Straw Hat Pirates tried worked on him. However, Vinsmoke Reiju sucked out the poison from Luffy via mouth-to-mouth, saving him with no ill-effects on her (and she even considered the poison to be a delicacy).

Territorial Sea Slugs (ナワバリウミウシ, Nawabari Umiushi) are sea slugs which live in the waters of Totto Land. It emits "warning waves" whenever someone comes to alert them to where they are. The waves are picked up by any Den Den Mushis in the encroaching ship. They were shown to enjoy listening to Charlotte Praline's singing.
These maritime creatures resemble very large centipedes with very sharp teeth and long tongues.

Many kinds of talking animals have been shown to inhabit Totto Land as citizens thanks to the power of Big Mom's Soru Soru no Mi which has turned them into anthropomorphic beings called Homies, allowing them to talk, stand upright and wear clothes like normal humans. At first glance, animal-type homies can be mistaken for members of the Mink Tribe, however the key difference is that they cannot use Electro. Another major difference is that while minks are limited to being based on mammalian animals, homies can be any kind of animal (or non-living object), ranging from reptiles, birds and amphibians. Animal Homies confirmed thus far include, crocodiles, cranes, frogs and rabbits.
Unicorns resemble zebras, which have a single long horn on their foreheads. A unicorn was captured by Big Mom and trapped within a book full of creatures by Mont-d'Or.

Doskoi Panda (ドスコイパンダ, Dosukoi Panda) is a species of rotund pandas who have rather short and curved legs. The brand Doskoi Panda is based off of them. One doskoi panda was captured by Big Mom and trapped within a book full of creatures by Mont-d'Or, and appeared to be very brutish.
A wanippo is a crocodile-like creature. One was captured by Big Mom and trapped within a book full of creatures by Mont-d'Or.

A type of large pig referred to as a Busha (豚車ブしゃ, Busha, literally "Pig Vehicle", or "Porkswagon") is used on Whole Cake Island as a carriage puller for party guests. It has BU95 tattooed on its side. "Bu" or "boo" is the Japanese onomatopoeia for the sound that pigs make, equivalent to "oink" in English.

While retrieving the Shark Submerge III, Chopper and Brook encountered a sea beast resembling a white tiger with glowing red eyes. It appeared in front of them and tried to eat them. They ran away and manage to elude it. The animal may be based on the shachihoko, a mythical creature with the body of a carp and the head of a tiger.

The Germa Kingdom uses large snails as the base for their land, having built platforms on their shell that when connected makes the kingdom's territory. The snails appearance resemble the Den Den Mushi, but are notably larger, each appears to be at least three times as wide as the Thousand Sunny. Those snails are seemingly unaffected by the salty sea, and are strong enough to climb the Red Line.

The snails double as a ship, to create the kingdom's fleet. There are two masts at the top of each ship, which carry large black sails bearing the number "66". Their shell is modified, having docking knobs for when the ships reassemble the kingdom, that resembles two portholes on each side. When gathered together, these snail ships will either remain in their shells or socialize with one another.

Nyasha is an extremely large cat that is used by the Vinsmoke Family to pull their royal carriage. Being the kingdom denizen, the cat wear a variation of the kingdom army uniform, consisting of a mask, headphones, an ascot, and a short, white, buttoned poncho. Nyasha is strong enough to pull a large carriage with the whole Vinsmoke Family on board.

The Germa 66 Soldiers are seen traveling in a cart that is pulled by a large mice behind the royal family carriage.

Normal-sized mice could also be found around the kingdom. Back when Sanji was a child, he was known to cook for stray mice, something that angered his father and brothers due to the attitude being seen as unfit of a royal.

Sutchies (スッチー, Succhī) are a type of large bug that resemble wasps and can be found on Zou. Their sting can weaken animals significantly larger than them and suck their blood with their needle-like mouths. The Mink Tribe kill every Sutchie they encounter in order to protect Zunesha. They are attracted to bright light.

Fruit Footballfish (フルーツチョウチンアンコウ, Furūtsu Chōchin-ankō) are fish that resemble giant fruit, allowing them to lure hungry prey. Their fanged faces blend in with their bodies, unseen until they attack. They live in the Mixed Juice Current of Totto Land, where seas of peach, orange, and watermelon juice mix together. There is a variant of fruit footballfish for each sea.

Luffy was seen catching a watermelon variant. It tried to eat him but he was able to stick a leg out its forehead and split it in half with a version of "Gomu Gomu no Axe" called "Gomu Gomu no Watermelon Splitting". He then caught an orange and a peach variant off-screen that were cut up into slices along with the watermelon one. Afterward Luffy, Chopper, and Carrot began eating the watermelon, peach, and orange variant respectively. Although Pedro said they were not poisonous, Nami was against eating them.

Spring Octopus (春ダコ, Haru-dako) is a species of octopus wearing a hachimaki headband. Before the Straw Hat Pirates arrived at Wano Country, one snuck on the Thousand Sunny in the water surrounding the country. It was seemingly able to lead a school of koi by calling to them with noises normally associated with kabuki plays. It also attempted to hold back Luffy from following his crewmates as they escaped a whirlpool, causing them to become separated.

Some spring octopuses are employed as sansuke (三助, male bath attendants) at the Flower Capital bathhouse, helping clients scrub their backs and wash their hair.

Dream Koi (夢鯉, Yume-goi) are gigantic koi that are known to inhabit Wano Country's seas. Despite being freshwater fish, they swim into the land by following the inward sea currents of the country. Once they arrive at the waterfall that brings the country's freshwater to the sea, the koi attempt to climb it by swimming up the stream. The Straw Hats were able to use these koi to reach the top of the waterfall through Luffy's Gomu Gomu no Mi, arriving at the Wano Country shortly after.

Madsaurus is a dinosaur species brought to Wano Country by the Beasts Pirates. It is a raptor-like dinosaur with a snake-like head. They are used by members of the Beasts Pirates as mounts. When two members of the Beasts Pirates and their mount attacked, Luffy easily defeated one of the two and then punched their mount which caused one of the riders to accidentally shoot his own beast in the head which caused an explosion, knocking out the mount followed with the remaining rider by Tama. Members of the Hawkins Pirates also ride these animals.

A Wanizame (ワニザメ, Wanizame) was seen by Luffy as it was chasing a tiger and a wild boar. It is a giant sea monster resembling a crocodile crossed with a shark with several dorsal fins on its back. Jack also used a Wanizame as his personal mount when he confronted Shutenmaru in Okobore Town.

It is based on the legendary Japanese sea dragon which was described as resembling a shark and a crocodile.

Koma's refer to large species of animals that are indigenous to Wano. They share the traits of being larger than their normal animal species counterpart, as well as possessing a tail and mane (in the case of birds, combs and wattle) with a flame-like appearance. So far, all known Koma species are mainly tamed by the denizens of Wano as mounts. They are predominantly mammals, with the exception of the Komatori, which is based on a rooster.

A large Komainu was encountered by Luffy shortly arriving at Wano Country, where it was being attacked by a giant baboon wielding a katana that sent it hurling into the Thousand Sunny. It is a giant creature with flame-like mane and tail that resembles a dog with a pig-like nose and a leonine body. The only named Komainu is Komachiyo.

A Komashika (狛鹿, Komashika) was used by Basil Hawkins as his personal mount when he confronted Luffy and Zoro in the wasteland. It is a deer-like creature with sharp teeth, largely curved antlers, spotted fur on its legs, a flame-like mane, and flame-like eyebrows. It resembles a Kirin.

A Komatori (狛鶏, Komatori) is a giant breed of rideable chicken with flame-like combs and wattles. Kin'emon and Inuarashi were seen riding these birds at Shimotsuki Yasuie's execution. They resemble the basan.

A Komadane is a Great Dane with spotted fur. They have a bushy tail and small tuffs of fur on their legs that resemble flames. They're large enough for an average sized person to ride on and one was ridden by the leader of Komurasaki's funeral procession.
A komagitsune is a fox with flame-like mane and tail. The only known komagitsune is Onimaru, who was once the companion of the late Shimotsuki Ushimaru and later became an ally of Kawamatsu.
A komauma is a horse with flame-like mane and tail. 20 years ago, they were used to pull Kurozumi Orochi's cart when he traveled to Kuri.

The Tanishi (タニシ, Tanishi, literally meaning "River Snail") is Wano Country's equivalent to the Den Den Mushi. Unlike the Den Den Mushi that are based on land snails, the Tanishi's shell spirals out like tower shell sea snails.

The Smart Tanishi (スマートタニシ, Sumāto Tanishi, literally meaning "Smart River Snail") or Smashi (スマシ, Sumashi) for short, is a small Tanishi used as a mobile and compact communication tool. Its shell is used as a handle for the user. Like the Den Den Mushi, the Smashi replicates the voice and expressions of the people on the other side of the call. However, unlike the Den Den Mushi, which is usually modified into a fixed shape by its owner, the Smashi can seemingly physically transform itself to resemble the person on the other side of the line. The Smashi is said to have a limited range and require a Boss Tanishi (親分タニシ, Oyabun Tanishi) in order to send signals long distance.
The Picture Tanishi (光画ひかりえタニシ, Hikarie Tanishi, literally meaning "Light Picture River Snail") is a larger Tanishi which is capable of broadcasting live video feeds.

The Boss Tanishi (親分タニシ, Oyabun Tanishi) is a large snail that is able to handle multiple signals of many Smashis and direct them to further distances, surpassing their limited range. One was stationed in Udon's Prisoner Mine's Executive Tower, but Caribou somehow stopped its broadcasts.

Hippo-Camel (フタコブカバ, Futa Kobu Kaba) are large creatures that strongly resembles Hippopotamus but has two humps on its back, similar to a species of camels. They are used as riding beasts by Caramel and Cidre's Bounty Hunter group. There seems to be two variants, a pink and grey colored, with the former only seen with Caramel. They seem durable enough to carry heavy loads.

A giant white tiger lives in the forest next to the Kuri Castle and wields a giant katana. It is territorial and enjoys combat, challenging Roronoa Zoro on a whim. It is strong enough to clash with the swordsman.

Horn Eaters (ツノクイ, Tsuno Kui) are a type of creature. They are large herbivorous armadillo-like rhinos that will aggressively attack any horned creature within sight, even if said creature happens to have fake horns, as seen with Luffy (Usopp had him garbed in a ridiculous costume with antlers included). They are used by Battler to herd the various other horned animals on Crown Island in order to chop their horns off.
A Messenger Pig (伝書ブタ, Densho Buta?) is a weird pig living on the Crown Island.

Box Rhinos (ハコサイ, Hako Sai, Manga Entertainment: "Square Rhinos") are animals with a rectangular form and loosely resemble rhinos that live on the Crown Island. When they lie on the ground, it is very easy to mistake them for rocks.
A Blue Goat (青ヤギ, Aoyagi) is a weird goat living on the Crown Island. It has blue stripes around its neck and torso, and its horns are round.

A Mohican Elephant is a weird elephant living on the Crown Island. As its name suggests, it has a mohican, similar to a horsehair, from its head to its tail. It has two rings for ears, mimicking the ear reamers that can be associated with punks, or people with mohicans.
A Lion Hippo (シシカバ, Shishi Kaba) is a weird hippopotamus living on the Crown Island. It has fur on its body, and what resembles a lion's mane.

A Hippo Rhino (カバサイ, Kabasai) is a purple rhino with a hippo's mouth. It can be mistaken for a rock when its head is downwards. It's also a good swimmer as it was able to swim far out to the sea. It fell in love with the Going Merry after it landed on it which made it spit out a fish it was choking on. It decided to swim to the Going Merry and propose to it.
Rosario was the giant pet goldfish owned by Muchigoro. It was a giant red fish with a hard metallic shell. The shell had jewels embedded on the top and on the forehead.

The Island Turtle (シマガメ, Shimagame), also known as Mecha Island, is a giant turtle that wakes every thousand years to lay its eggs. These eggs are considered extremely valuable due to being made of gold.

The Water Lizard (水中トカゲ, Suichū Tokage) is a type of reptile that exist in one of the islands swallowed by Bonbori. Two Water Lizards, who are named Elizabeth and Chavez, are adopted by Myskina Olga and her father and now live with them after escaping from Bonbori's stomach. They have the ability to run on water, with up to two people on their back.

Giant Footballfish (巨大なチョウチンアンコウ, Kyodaina Chōchin'ankō) are a type of large fish that roams though the New World. The inside of its body is somehow far larger than the outside, having three stomachs big enough to hold an island. They resemble giant anglerfish, and the digestion of Pure Gold causes a bright golden light to build up in their escas. The only known specimen is Bonbori, who has a strong desire to eat Pure Gold; whether this is a trait of the species as a whole or only Bonbori is unclear.

The Muscle Turtles (マッスルカメ, Massuru Kame?) are small turtles that were enslaved by Gild Tesoro and made to power the various automobiles, known as Turtle Cars (カメ車, Kamesha), on the Gran Tesoro. After the island was sprayed with sea water and Tesoro was defeated, the Muscle Turtles most likely gained their freedom.

The Gigant Turtles (ギガントタートル, Giganto Tātoru) are massive turtles nearly a third the size of the Gran Tesoro (which itself stretches 10 km long) that were tamed and harnessed to the ship. Two of them are attached to the Gran Tesoro, and are tasked with protection of the ship from Sea Kings and sea creatures that would do the ship harm. Furthermore, they both have what appears to be a massive cannon attached to their back.

The Red-eyed Owls (赤目フクロウ, Akame Fukurō) are a species of owls tasked with monitoring a passage way that leads to the Tesoro's Hyper Suite, where a safe containing a fortune lies. The Red-eyed Owls' gaze emits light, and as soon as anything living is caught in their gaze, they will scream and alert security. However, their gazes move at set intervals, so it is possible to avoid the lights, especially if one can understand their speech.

Golden Bats are a ferocious species of bats that guard the pipeline to the Gran Tesoro's saltwater pump. Although they may prove formidable to normal people, they were instantly defeated when faced against the likes of Luffy and Franky.

Dragons (竜ドラゴン, Doragon) are large winged reptiles of great power and ferocity that are capable of breathing fire. One resided in the Wano Country long ago.

The powers and abilities of a dragon are so strong that not only can it destroy a single town (under the control of D.R. and Cyrano with the use of a Dragon Horn) and bring terror to the public, but killing one made the samurai Ryuma a legend, and stories about him are still passed down after generations.

Dragons were first mentioned by Hogback in the One Piece storyline during the Thriller Bark Arc, where he revealed to Zoro the story of Ryuma and his legendary slaying of a dragon long ago which the latter took in with much skepticism.

Dr. Vegapunk was revealed to have created his own artificial dragons to guard Punk Hazard, which appear like Western dragons. He had tried thirteen times to create his own dragons, but each one failed except for Dragon Number Thirteen and a smaller unnamed model. The Straw Hats encountered these two, both of which were incredibly strong, and one possessing great speed as well. However, both were eventually killed by Kin'emon and the Straw Hats.

There are also wingless Eastern dragons introduced during the Punk Hazard Arc. Kaidou is revealed to have eaten the Uo Uo no Mi, Model: Seiryu that allows him to become one, specifically the Azure Dragon. His dragon form is also perfectly capable of simulating flight via "Flame Clouds". However, his fierce personality and destructive abilities are more similar to that of the Western dragons, being capable of breathing fire and destroying large areas. Momonosuke also ate Vegapunk's failed Artificial Devil Fruit, which was meant to duplicate Kaidou's Devil Fruit, allowing him to turn into a small pink Chinese dragon.

There are also two other dragon species, the Sennenryu and the Seahorse Dragon.
Rocs (怪鳥ルク, Ruku, literally meaning "Monster Bird") are giant panda-like birds. Balloon is the last of his kind. Spiel wanted Balloon for the magical blood Rocs possess.

The Tomahawk Spiny Lobster (トマホーク・伊勢ロブスター, Tomahōku Ise Robusutā) is a very rare, gigantic lobster most likely from the East Blue based on it being listed in “East Blue Ingredients Encyclopedia”.

It is able to live in fresh and saltwater habitats. Instead of pincers on its arms, it has boast razor-sharp blades in the shape of axes. It hides in rivermouth slit deposits and uses its blades to hunt fish passing by. Its incredibly tough upper shell has been used as wartime armor and in pre-war victory rituals. In cooking, it is a very difficult ingredient to prepare that even first-rated chefs from top-class restaurants would struggle with this ingredient.

The Draconic Super-Fillet Salmon (ドラゴニック・超フィレサーモン, Doragonikku Chō-Fire Sāmon), also called the "Dragon Salmon" (龍鮭, Ryūjake), is a species of salmon with a long sinuous body that brings to mind the imaginary dragon. They only gather during mating season, swimming in schools of hundreds. Their flesh is considered more tender and delicious than beef tenderloin and is thought to bring good luck to those who eat it.

Its stomach is its most tender part and is particularly sensitive to a blade; opening it up successfully requires a perfectly straight singular cut that cannot be even a millimeter off. The slightest hesitation or waver will trigger its defense mechanism, causing it to pop like a balloon and explode all of its delicious flesh into useless scraps. Sanji failed to cook it using his own kitchen knives. He succeeded by using one of Zoro's swords, which had the length, sharpness, and sturdiness he needed.
The Momoiro Fish (モモイロ魚, Momoiro Gyo) is a fish found in the sea near Momoiro Island. It has a heart shape eye socket. It is the main ingredient in Sanji's Momoiro Fish Acqua Pazza.
The Momoiro Duck (モモイロ鴨, momoiro Kamo) is a type of duck found in Momoiro Island. Its appearance is unknown since it was only mentioned as the main ingredient in Sanji's Momoiro Duck Tagliata.

The Scarlet Red Ram (スカーレット・レッドヒツジ, Sukāretto Reddo Hitsuji) is a breed of placid mountain sheep in the East Blue. They are mentioned in The Encyclopedia of Rare and Unique Ingredients to have a tender meat with and aroma reminiscent of strawberries and wine. Their meat is the main ingredient in Huge Revolver Mutton Stake. At the age of one year old, the lamb mature into a mutton, and experience a gigantic growth spurt, making their meat taste stronger, and they develop an extremely tough layer of body fat.

The Balloon Bird (気球鳥, Kikyū Tori) is a kind of bird that falls from a Sky Island down to Resorto. Its meat is delicious but expands when eaten, meaning that most people only need to eat one piece to become full. Eating too much of the meat can be dangerous, as it continues to expand in the stomach, and medical intervention is required to remedy overconsumption.

The Tongari Ton (トンガリトン, Tongari Ton) is a pig species that lives on Tongari Island. It has rosy cheeks and a striped, square horn, and it is said to be very tasty when eaten. It is described as a "rare phantom beast," and it can only be caught if someone deciphers an ancient riddle to find its nest.
Man-Eating Tuna are a type of giant tuna that live in the East Blue, around Tony-Tony Island. The residents of the island fish and eat them, and they're considered to taste good.
Man-Eating Sharks are a type of shark that live in the East Blue, around Tony-Tony Island.

Usodabird is a giant bird created by Dr. Usodabada. He was sent to cover various islands, one of which was Tony-Tony Island, in giant poop. He was eventually defeated by Chopperman, marking the first time that Chopperman defeated a global threat.

Usodabird is a giant black bird with Dr. Usodabada's curled moustache and horns, as well as a swirl mark on his forehead.

Little is known about Usodabird's personality, but he was seemingly intelligent enough to take orders from Dr. Usodabada and navigate to various islands.
A Metsutsutcha Katapad is a small, extremely strong bird resembling a chick. They have the ability to easily smash through brick walls, and can resist Chimpy's abilities while remaining unfazed.

A Road Snake is a type of giant snake living on the Boin Archipelago. They have a vaguely phallic shape, resembling an eel extending from a pair of walking buttcheeks, and are yellow with a black design and black spots.

keys: Macho Man Who Looks Like an Old Man With a Carrot Growing on his Head
entries.content: A Macho Man Who Looks Like an Old Man With a Carrot Growing on his Head is an animal living on the Boin Archipelago. They bury themselves underground, resembling a normal carrot in the ground; however, when picked, they reveal their full form. Like their name describes, they look like very tall, extremely muscular people with carrot stems on top of their heads. Despite their human appearance, they are not intelligent. The only known example of the species is Dareyorimo Tsuyoi, who was later identified as an alien; it is unclear if Funkorogasun simply misidentified Tsuyoi's species, or if Macho Man Who Looks Like an Old Man With a Carrot Growing on his Head originate from space.

A Deadline Dragon (乄切めき竜, Meki Ryū) is a dragon resembling a Chinese dragon with at least six arms. They live in waters on Gourmet Island, and have a Capture Level of 1, the lowest numerical score. Three attacked Luffy and Toriko while they were on the island, but were easily defeated by Toriko.

The Deadline Dragons seem to be based on real-life Shonen Jump editors, with each wearing headbands signifying a different editor's name. Specifically included are Kosuke Yahagi, the original editor of Naruto and eventual Editor-in-Chief of Jump SQ; Koike, eventual editor at Shonen Jump+; and Hiroyuki Nakano, eventual Editor-in-Chief of Weekly Shonen Jump.

keys: Pig In a Fox In a Tiger
entries.content:
A Pig In a Fox In a Tiger is a mammal found on Gourmet Island with an unknown Capture Level. One attacked Luffy and Toriko while they were on the island, but it was easily defeated by Luffy.

It's name is likely a pun on the Japanese idiom "a fox borrowing a tiger's menace" (虎の威を借る狐, Tora no i wo karu kitsune?), referring to a person without authority acting as if they do.

The Umbrella Frog (アマガサガエル, Amagasa Gaeru) is a small frog with green skin, red markings on its sides, and a brown underbelly. It dislikes rain enough to wear a hat. However, it shows up by the waterside all the time, so it does not hate water. They can be found in Unlimited Adventure's Seaside Zone and Cave Zone.

The Weir Storm Mouse (ヤナアラシネズミ, Yana-arashi Nezumi) is a mouse covered in long blonde fur. It subsists on whatever grass it can find, and sometimes mistakes its own fur for grass. Its name can be also known as the "Tempest Mouse." They can be found in Unlimited Adventure's Ruins Zone and Mountain Zone, and on Unlimited Cruise, they can be found in traps on the Thousand Sunny and on Iceberg Island.

The Jungle Lizard (ジャングルオオトカゲ, Janguru Ōtokage) is a green lizard with a "crown" on its head (a golden protrusion shaped like a crown). They are calm, composed creatures, though they will panic when danger is near. They can be found in Unlimited Adventure's Jungle Zone.

The Hidden Forest Bee (モリノカクレバチ, Mori-no-kakure Bachi) is a particularly dangerous species of bees with black and green stripes. However, they gather medicinal plants and can be used to neutralize poison. They can be found in Unlimited Adventure's Jungle Zone.

The Oil Stain Frog (アブラジミガエル, Aburajimi Gaeru) is a small brown frog with a red underbelly. They are always covered in oil and ooze, but they can be squeezed to make a special oil used for cooking or development of explosives. Its name can be also known as the "Greasy Frog." They can be found in Unlimited Adventure's Ruins Zone.

The Purple Poison Frog (ドクムラサキガエル, Doku Murasaki Gaeru) is a purple frog with a sinister pattern on its body, include black spots, yellow webbing between its toes, yellow markings on its head and back, and a red underbelly. It dwells in underground caves, and its body is covered in a dangerous poison. They can be found in Unlimited Adventure's Cave Zone.

The Fire Hercules (ファイヤーヘラクレス, Faiyā Herakuresu) is a type of Hercules beetle colored red, with markings on its back that look like a raging fire. The color is appealing, and these beetles usually dwell in fire. They can be found in Unlimited Adventure's Ruins Zone and Unlimited Cruise's Cave Island and Desert Island.

The Doze Evil Eye Butterfly (イネムリジャノメチョウ, Inemuri Janome Chō) is a butterfly with a pattern like a closed eye on its wings. They can scatter their scales, causing enemies to fall asleep. Its name can also be known as the "Sleeping Butterfly." They can be found in Unlimited Adventure's Ruins Zone, Cave Zone, and Dimension Zone.

In Unlimited Cruise, the Doze Evil Eye Butterfly has a different appearance. While it maintains a sleep enducing design on its wings resembling closed eyes, like its original variant, this variety has a pattern on its wings that resembles a starry night. It can also be called the Sleep Butterfly. They can be found on Unlimited Cruise's Iceberg Island.

The Horned Icicle Lizard (ツノツララトカゲ, Tsuno Tsurara Tokage) is a lizard with a snow white body and an icicle on its head that will quickly regrow if broken. It is the only lizard that lives in the cold. Its name in the English versions of Unlimited Adventure and Unlimited Cruise is the "Icicle Lizard." They can be found in Unlimited Adventure's Mountain Zone and on Unlimited Cruise's Iceberg Island.

The Ice Miyama Stag Beetle (コオリミヤマクワガタ, Kōri Miyama Kuwagata) is a beetle with a shimmering blue-white carapace and beautiful pincers that look like ice shards. It is an unusual variant that is active in winter. Its name can also be known as the "Ice Beetle." They can be found in Unlimited Adventure's Mountain Zone and on Unlimited Cruise's Iceberg Island.

The Lantern Firefly (チョウチンホタル, Chōchin Hotaru) is a firefly whose glowing abdomen is shaped like a paper lantern. These fireflies typically gather by riverbeds in large numbers. They can be found in Unlimited Adventure's Cave Zone.

The Giant Devil Hand Moth (デビルハンドオオガ, Debiru Hando Ō Ga) is a black-colored, evil-looking moth with purple eyes, blue markings on its back, and a demonic hand-like design on its wings. Its wings' scales can cause unconsciousness. They can be found in Unlimited Adventure's Cave Zone and on Unlimited Cruise's Wetland Island.

The Crossbone Butterfly (クロスボーンバタフライ, Kurosubōn Batafurai) is a brown butterfly with green eyes and bone-shaped wings. The cross design on its abdomen serves as a warning to enemies as it flies away. However, it is considered lucky among pirates. They can be found in Unlimited Adventure's Dimension Zone and on Unlimited Cruise's Wetland Island.

The Rainbow Phoenix is a butterfly with beautiful wings that look like stained glass. It heals very quickly, and its scales can become a potent medicine. They can be found in Unlimited Adventure's Dimension Zone and on Unlimited Cruise's Floating Island.

The Golden Hercules (ゴールデンヘラクレス, Gōruden Herakuresu) is a shining, golden Hercules beetle. It is a rare and valuable insect, and thus is called a "small hero." They can be found in Unlimited Adventure's Plain Zone and Seaside Zone, and on Unlimited Cruise's Gorge Island and Island of Recollection.

The Lovely Angel (ラブリーエンゼル, Raburī Enzeru) is a tropical fish with heart-shaped eyes. They look beautiful when swimming, almost angelic. They can be found in Unlimited Adventure's Plain Zone, Seaside Zone, Ruins Zone, Cave Zone, and Dimension Zone, as well as on Unlimited Cruise's Floating Island.

The Island Clam (シマアサリ, Shima Asari) is a showy species of clam with a vivid striped pattern. They have as many adductor muscles as stripes, and these muscles are shaped like the island in Unlimited Adventure. This makes them hard to open, but their meat is delicious. They can be found in Unlimited Adventure's Plain Zone and Seaside Zone, as well as on Unlimited Cruise's Forest Island and Memory Island. It is also called the "Striped Clam."
The Cutie Piranha (キューティーピラニア, Kyūtī Pirania) is a timid-looking fish that is just as vicious as other piranhas. They can be found in Unlimited Adventure's Jungle Zone and Cave Zone.

The Scissor Shrimp (ハサミエビ, Hasami Ebi) is a shrimp with large pincers, looking almost lobster-like. The strong muscles they use in their pincers make them delicious. They can be found in Unlimited Adventure's Plain Zone, Seaside Zone, and Mountain Zone, as well as on Unlimited Cruise's Gorge Island and Cave Island. It is also called the "Clawed Shrimp."

The Adventure Fish (アドベンチャーフィッシュ, Adobenchā Fisshu) is an unusual fish that boldly explores its surroundings and puts things in it finds in a pocket. The contents of the pocket vary. It is regarded as a "living fossil" as it remains unchanged from prehistoric times. They can be found in Unlimited Adventure's Plain Zone, Seaside Zone, Cave Zone, Mountain Zone, and Dimension Zone, as well as on Unlimited Cruise's Gorge Island and Iceberg Island.

The Pumpkin Octopus is an octopus with a pumpkin-shaped head, which is likely an evolutionary trait to keep them from being caught in octopus jars. They can be found in Unlimited Adventure's Seaside Zone.

The Autumn Leaves Salmon (紅葉シャケ, Kōyō Shake) is a salmon with fins shaped like autumn leaves. It is a delicate fish that never settles in one place. Its name can also be known as the "Red Salmon." They can be found in Unlimited Adventure's Ruins Zone.

The Lava Flounder (溶岩ヒラメ, Yōgan Hirame) is an unusual flounder that lives in lava. It swims to the surface of the lava several times a day, but it is very difficult to see. They can be found in Unlimited Adventure's Cave Zone.

The Treasure Pargai (トレジャーパールガイ, Torejā Pārugai) is a shellfish that holds a pearl so large it cannot close its shell. Sometimes it grows so large it breaks the shell and only the pearl is left. They can be found in Unlimited Adventure's Seaside Zone and Dimension Zone, as well as on Unlimited Cruise's Forest Island. It is also called the "Treasure Shell."

The Electric Catfish (カンデンキナマズ, Kandenki Namazu) is a catfish whose body is surrounded by electricity. This was caused by a lightning strike and allows it to deliver shocks. They can be found in Unlimited Adventure's Jungle Zone.

The Devil Bonito (オニガツオ, Oni Gatsuo) is a bonito with a demonic, angry-looking face. The fish itself is very delicious when prepared seared or raw. They can be found in Unlimited Adventure's Ruins Zone.

The Guidance Monkfish (導きアンコウ, Michibiki Ankō) is a monkfish with a glowing, lantern-like feeler. It is not often attacked, but the feeler lets it turn the tables on would-be predators. They can be found in Unlimited Adventure's Cave Zone.
The Icefish is a fish whose body is covered in ice. If its body temperature goes above 32 degrees, the ice will begin to thaw. They can be found in Unlimited Adventure's Mountain Zone.

The Beat Alligator (ビートアリゲーター, Bīto Arigētā) is an alligator with fins instead of legs, letting it swim much faster than a typical alligator. It was once a land-dweller before it returned to the sea. Its meat is considered a delicacy. They can be found in Unlimited Adventure's Jungle Zone and on Unlimited Cruise's Wetland Island.

The Aurora Sunfish (オーロラマンボー, Ōrora Manbō) is a sunfish that shines with rainbow colors as a result of sleeping in a prismatic lake. Now it can only live in that lake. They can be found in Unlimited Adventure's Dimension Zone.
The Burning Dragon was originally a massive and ferocious aquatic reptile. They love very hot places and are most comfortable in lava. They can be found in Unlimited Adventure's Cave Zone.

The Great Terigius (グレートテリギウス, Gurēto Terigiusu) is an aquatic reptile thought to be extinct. It is a vicious creature and attacks without mercy. They can grow more than 95 feet long and are considered by some to be small Sea Kings. They can be found in Unlimited Adventure's Seaside Zone and on Unlimited Cruise's Memory Island.

The Golden Whale (ゴールデンホエール, Gōruden Hoēru) is a whale that shows off its amazing golden color. They are very rare, and they are seldom seen together. They can be found in Unlimited Adventure's Seaside Zone.

The Doctor Hornet (ドクトルホーネット, Dokutoru Hōnetto) is a rare hornet with a stinger resembling a hypodermic syringe. It is nicknamed the "Forest Doctor" because the liquid it secretes from its stinger counteracts poison. They can be found on Unlimited Cruise's Gorge Island, Desert Island, and Island of Recollection.

The Thunder Scarab (カミナリコガネ, Kaminari Kogane) is an ancient beetle resurrected from amber. The beetle has a horn shaped like a lightning bolt, and it is able to emit strong electric shocks. Its name can also be known as the "Lightning Beetle." They can be found on Unlimited Cruise's Forest Island and Floating Island.

The Flying Penguin (ソラトビペンギン, Soratobi Pengin) is a penguin that, over time, gained the ability to fly through evolution. It has blue and white fur that forms in a swirly pattern on its back, and it wears a pink aviator hat and brown goggles. They can be found on the outer edge of Unlimited Cruise's Iceberg Island.

The Rockin Lizard (ロッキンリザード, Rokkin Rizādo) is an orange lizard that prefers dry, arid climates. It has a rock-like body that sways as it moves, but despite its rugged looks, its skin is used to produce high-grade leather. Its name can also be known as the "Rock Lizard." They can be found on Unlimited Cruise's Gorge Island and Desert Island.

The A Class Toad (A級トード, Ē-kyū Tōdo) is a brown toad that evolved to look identical to a woolly mammoth. It has yellow eyes, large tusks, earlike flaps on the sides of its head, toes that resemble hooves, and three red stars running down its back. It is considered the ultimate amphibian as it can live in frozen areas and is a prized delicacy. Its name can also be called the "Mammoth Toad." They can be found on Unlimited Cruise's Iceberg Island.

The Lightbulb Firefly (デンキュウホタル, Denkyū Hotaru) is a firefly shaped like a light bulb. It inhabits dark areas like caves because it believes its mission is to light the darkness. Its name is also known as the "Light Bulb Firefly." They can be found on Unlimited Cruise's Cave Island.

The Lantern Trilobite (チョウチン三葉虫, Chōchin Sanyōchū) is a cave-dwelling creature that has kept the same form since prehistoricc times. It has two paper lantern-like antennae. Their purpose is unknown, and they often get in the trilobite's way. They can be found in shallow waters on Unlimited Cruise's Cave Island.

The Superstar Starfish is a brightly-colored starfish with vivid orange and teal colors. Though it stands out, it is never attacked by other organisms, possibly due to its popularity. They can be found on Unlimited Cruise's Cave Island.

The Fist Crayfish (ゲンコツザリガニ, Genkotsuzarigani) is a crayfish whose pincers have evolved into fists, supposedly due to its fighting spirit. It wears gloves over its fists because they are dangerous. They can be found on Unlimited Cruise's Forest Island, Gorge Island, and Memory Island.

The Mata Killifish (マタメダカ, Matamedaka) is a killifish with a forked tail fin. It is small and can be easily caught, so it is often let go, only to be caught again. Its name is also known as the "Forked-Tail Killifish." They can be found on Unlimited Cruise's Forest Island, Gorge Island, Desert Island, and Swamp Island.

The Smile Jellyfish (スマイルクラゲ, Sumairukurage) is a jellyfish with a face pattern on its dome. While the smiling design is cute, fishermen catch them frequently and grow tired of them. Its name is also known as the "Smiley Jellyfish." They can be found on Unlimited Cruise's Forest Island, Iceberg Island, and Memory Island, as well as in the waters off the edge of the Thousand Sunny.

The Butterflyfish (チョウチョウウオ, Chōchō̄o) is a tropical fish that is popular for its grace and orange-and-cream color. It usually swims in schools, but it is also a curious fish that will often approach divers. Its name is also known as the "Oriental Butterflyfish." They can be found on Unlimited Cruise's Gorge Island and Cave Island.

The Glistening Saury (ギラギラサンマ, Giragirasanma) is a saury with brightly glittering scales. It swims in schools and tries to proct itself that way, but the schools themselves are often preyed upon. Its name is also known as the "Shining Saury." They can be found on Unlimited Cruise's Forest Island and in the waters off the edge of the Thousand Sunny.

The Salamandra (サラマンドラ, Saramandora) is a salamander that evolved to have plants growing on its back. These plants have medicinal benefits. Its name is also known as the "Salamandrake," a combination of salamander and the mandrake plant. They can be found on Unlimited Cruise's Gorge Island and Desert Island.

The Balloon Catfish (フウセンナマズ, Fuusen'namazu) is a balloon-shaped catfish that draws in water, then jets it out the back to propel itself. It may be related to the globefish. They can be found on Unlimited Cruise's Forest Island and Desert Island.

The Koala Sunfish (コーラセマンボウ, Kōrasemanbou) is a sunfish born in frigid waters. It has a shell made out of ice on its back, making it hard to distinguish from drifting ice. Its name is also known as the "Ice Sunfish." They can be found on Unlimited Cruise's Iceberg Island and Memory Island.

The Skull Knight (スカルナイト, Sukarunaito) is a distant cousin of the ammonite that has supposedly been long extinct. It wears the skulls of other creatures, the reasons for which scholars consider a mystery. They can be found on Unlimited Cruise's Gorge Island.

The Clawed Scorpion (カギツメスコーピオン, Kagitsumesukōpion) is a dangerous scorpion with sharp claws that emit poison. This poison is used as a toxicant by humans. It attacks anyone that approaches it. They can be found on Unlimited Cruise's Desert Island.

The Antlion Lacewing (ウスバアリジゴク, Usubaarijigoku) is an adult giant antlion. It retains a similar appearance to its larval state but is timid and smaller in length as an adult. They can be found on Unlimited Cruise's Desert Island.

The Red-Eyed Spotted Frog (アカメマダライボガエル, Akamemadaraibogaeru) is a spotted frog with eerie-looking red eyes. Despite its appearance, it is not poisons and is known for its exquisite meat. They can be found on Unlimited Cruise's Wetland Island.

The Human Soul Firefly (人魂蛍, Hitodama hotaru) is a firefly that emits a spirit-like light. It is said to suck energy from those who touch it, and it cannot be caught with a normal net. Its name is also known as the "Spirit Firefly." They can be found on Unlimited Cruise's Wetland Island.

The Thunder Spider (カミナリグモ, Kaminarigumo) is a spider that lives only at high altitudes. Its webs carry an electric current, making them powerful and difficult to remove. They can be found on Unlimited Cruise's Floating Island.

The Bone Fish (ボーンフィッシュ, Bōnfisshu) is a rare fish that only lives in desert oases. It attacks with the bonelike thorns on its back when approached by other organisms. They can be found on Unlimited Cruise's Desert Island.

The Missile Manta (ミサイルマンタ, Misairumanta) is a manta ray armed with a mysterious weapon. It refracts sunlight with its body, which makes it difficult to see from above. Its name is also known as the "Missile Manta Ray." They can be found on Unlimited Cruise's Memory Island.

The Hydramandra (ハイドラマンドラ, Haidoramandora) is a vicious amphibian and a distant cousin of the Salamandra. Like its cousin, it is also used as a medicinal ingredient and has incredible vitality. Its name is also known as the "Hydramandrake." They can be found on Unlimited Cruise's Wetland Island.

The Giant Sky Fish (ダイテンクウギョ, Daitenkuugyo) is a fish that swims in the clouds like the Sky Fish. Its body is light despite its size, as it is build like a balloon. Its meat is said to be chewy and delicious. They can be found on Unlimited Cruise's Floating Island.

The Tatsunoko is a small yellow seahorse species. It is said to be delicious and expensive due to how difficult it is to catch. It is nutritious and a great source for evolving new kinds of fish. It is also known as a "Sea Pony."

The Tatsunowaka is the evolved form of the Tatsunoko. It is considered a high-caliber, luxury food item and is highly effective as a restorative drug. It is 2★ rarity. It is also called the "Sea Colt."

The Tatsunomikoto is the evolved form of the Tatsunokawa. It is said to be so delicious that once you consume it, you will never be able to eat another fish again. Those who consume it are also said to never suffer from illness again. It is 3★ rarity. It is also called the "Sea Horse."

The Tatsunoou is the evolved form of the Tatsunomikoto and legendary creature said to be the guardian of the sea. It is said to grant long life, and no one knows where it lives. It is 4★ rarity and appears least frequently among all of the seahorse forms. It is also called the "Sea Stallion."

The Eisa (エイサー, Eisā) is an ape-like creature with maroon fur, round eyes, thick lips, a round head, long arms, and short legs. It also has a tail and stripes on its body. Eisas typically gather and fight in groups, and they hop back and forth, switching which leg they support themselves which each time. They are hostile toward strangers like pirates. The Eisa is able to say its own name, "Eisa." The Eisa are born from cube data fragments around Waford, and use them to attack and duplicate.

The Hieisa (ヒエイサー, Hieisā) are closely related to Eisa, except they are light blue instead of maroon-colored. The name is probably a pun on "hiehie" (冷え冷え/ひえひえ?), which means means "feeling chilly/cold" in Japanese. Being ice variants of the Eisa, they dislike heat and the Achisa.

The Oisa (オイサー, Oisā) are closely related to Eisa, except they are larger, with a red head, yellow and brown-striped body, and golden horns. They have a single, larger horn sticking out of the top of their head, surrounded by green fur.
The Hoisa (ホイサー, Hoisā) are closely related to Eisa, except they are teal instead of maroon-colored.

The Achisa (アチイサー, Achiisā) are closely related to Eisa, except they are brown and orange instead of maroon-colored. They also resemble takoyaki with the green speckling on their heads and a stick poking out of the side. They live in the Memoria version of the Arabasta Kingdom created by the Straw Hat Pirates, primarily in open desert areas.

The Yoisa (ヨイサー, Yoisā) are closely related to Eisa, except they are bright yellow and generally smaller. Unlike the Eisa, they're peaceful creatures, and certain individuals are highly intelligent, even being able to understand human speech (though not speak it).

Shinobi Yoisa (しのびヨイサー, Shinobi Yoisā) are a species of black Yoisa with the ability to extract someone's memories into a Record Cube. They are known for doing it without people's consent, to Lim's annoyance. Like Yoisa, they have the ability to teleport themselves. Their name is sldo known as the Ninja Yoisa.
The Monogusa (モノグサー, Monogusā) are closely related to Eisa, except they are gray and purple. Their bodies are polluted with poison, which they use as a weapon when needed.

The Doeisa (ドエイサー, Doeisā) are a species related to Eisa, born instead from large cubes. They are much larger than other Eisas, and act as their boss. It's said that Doeisa were the original Eisa, born from the memories of an ancient warrior.

The Hidélie Penguin (ひでリー ペンギン, Hiderī Pengin) is a penguin species with blue and white feathers, a red plume on the top of its head, droopy eyes, and a long tongue that often hangs out of its beak. Its name is likely a pun on an Adélie penguin (アデリーペンギン, Aderī Pengin?). Hidélie Penguins are not inherently hostile creatures, but when driven by hunger, they are willing to consumer humans and will attack in relation. The Hidélie Penguin's name is also known as the "Dry Penguin".

Despite their aloof demeanor and simple motivations, the Hidélie Penguin has speed and dexterity. Using a technique called the Slash Slide, the Hidélie Penguin charges at an enemy, jumps in the air, and slides forward quickly, slicing its foe with its beak.
The Cooly Penguin is a subspecies of Hidélie Penguin that enjoys the cold. They have feathers resembling knit caps on their heads.
The Baribari Penguin is a species of Hidélie Penguin that left the pack and eventually evolved into a new species.

The Black-Hearted Mouse (腹黒マウス, Haraguro Mausu) is a bipedal rodent species with gray fur, a curled tail, and short limbs. It wears a purple hat and orange shorts, and it often has a smug grin on its face.

The Black-Hearted Mouse is officially called the Grand Line House Mouse (グランドラインイエネズミ, Gurando Rain ie Nezumi), while the more commonly known name is merely a nickname based on their personalities.
The Funny Mouse is a subspecies of the Black-Hearted Mouse. Their hats are decorations made from hardened fur.
The Nouveau Riche Mouse is a subspecies of Black-Hearted Mouse. They love shiny things, and will invades the houses of rich people to steal. Their name is also known as Upstart Mouse.

The Kaio Dragon (カイオウ ドラゴン, Kaiō Doragon, English localization: "Leviathan") is a bipedal dragon with droopy eyes and a large fin that resembles a Spinosaurus. They are at the top of the food chain in the Arabasta Kingdom, and frequently eat poisonous lizards, giving them chronic stomach aches and sometimes causing them to spray paralytic stomach acid.

The Dogol Dragon is a subspecies of Kaio Dragon living in the Ice Block Ruins. They eat rocks and minerals, though sometimes mistake ice for rocks and try to eat them, causing them to spray out cold air.
The Shay-King Dragon is a subspecies of Kaio Dragon that revolve around the maracas on their head. They do everything to a rhythm, and hate loud sounds because it messes them up.
The Bronze Bat is a bat species similar to the Golden Bat, except it has bronze fur and bright, orange eyes. They live all across the Grand Line.

The Silver Bat (シルバーバット, Shirubābatto) is a bat species similar to the Golden Bat, except it has silver feathers and bright, blue eyes. It attacks by biting enemies with its large jaws. They are very long-lived, sometimes living for hundreds of years.

The Navi Bird is a pink bird with an orange face and purble, blue, and orange feathers down its wings and back. It has small eyes and a large, brown beak. If it is fed desert nuts, it will guide the person who fed it. It gets angry when others eat its food.
The Smiley Risu (ニヤ・リス, or "Smiley Squirrel") is a green, smiling variant of the Death Risu that lives in the Thunderhead Ruins on Waford.

The Lip Risu (リップ・リス, Rippu Risu or "Lip Squirrel") is a grey variant of the Death Risu that looks like it's wearing heavy makeup. At some point in the past, they ruled over a nameless island, but were caught in a tornado and fell to Waford.

The Shock Kabuto (ビリリカブト, literally meaning "Shock Beetle") is a yellow lightning-based variant of the Kaen Kabuto that lives in the Thunderhead Ruins on Waford. Unlike the Kaen Kabuto, they are unable to fly.
The Frozen Kabuto (ヒョウケツカブト, or "Frozen Beetle") is a blue ice-based variant of the Kaen Kabuto that lives in the Ice Block Ruins on Waford. They are unable to fly.

The Unripe Bananawani (半熟バナナワニ, Hanjuku Bananawani or "Unripe Banana Crocodile") is a subspecies of the Bananawani. They are smaller and relatively gentle, but tend to wander into the desert, and will still attack people. Unlike the Bananawani, the banana on their head is only half-ripe.
The Desert Bananawani (デザートバナナワニ, Dezāto Bananawani,  or "Desert Banana Crocodile") is a subspecies of the Bananawani that live in the desert. They have the ability to swim in sand.

The Bushy Bananawani (フサフサバナナワニ, Fusafusa Bananawani, or "Fluffy Banana Crocodile") is a large, long-lived relative of the Bananawani. They are considered highly intelligent, often leading packs of Bananawani. Their name is also known as Bushy Banana Gator.
